name: Voter Action Project Voter Registration Team
subject: Must increase registration nationwide
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
We refuse to give up the fight to increase voter participation across the country. That means refocusing our anger and our energy on registering and turning out every voter we can .
Massive voter participation is more crucial now than ever. RUSH $30 or more today and help us register a tidal wave of new voters nationwide >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=081826_4&amount=30]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
The Supreme Court ruled in favor of voter suppression and against underrepresented communities in Louisiana v. Callais , folks.
This is a devastating blow to voting rights, but it only serves to strengthen our resolve . If anti-voting forces are going to stack the deck against the communities we serve, then we will work even harder to engage and rally these voters, lift their voices, and defend their right to vote .
How? Voter registration is a critical part of grassroots efforts to protect voting rights. The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. If you're with us in this fight, chip in $30 or whatever you can today to help register 10 new voters >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=081826_4&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=081826_4&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=081826_4&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=081826_4&amount=50]

Despite vote-suppressing courts and state legislatures making it harder to register to vote -- passing bills to stop organizations like ours and our partners on the ground from helping potential voters navigate the increasingly murky rules around voter registration -- we're still pulling out all the stops to bring voters into the system.
Voter participation has been increasing, and young people -- a major target of opponents of voting rights -- see the importance of voting now more than ever. Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
The midterm election will determine whether our democracy stays mired in the darkness and conspiracy theories we hear every day or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and move forward to a better future.
Our voter registration work -- at just about $3 per new voter -- is more necessary now than ever. Can you pitch in with $30 and give us the resources we need to register a tidal wave of new voters ahead of the 2026 deadlines? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=081826_4&amount=30]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=081826_4&amount=20]

Wednesday’s deadline marks the LAST time we’ll report our fundraising to the FEC before the primary election. That means it’s our LAST chance to prove we can defeat the MAGA billionaires who are dumping money into this race to try to buy the Granite State’s Senate seat.
It’s no exaggeration to say this is the biggest test our campaign has faced so far. And our ability to keep New Hampshire’s Senate seat blue and flip control of the Senate will come down to whether we can raise enough to build a winning campaign.
**We need to take this opportunity to show the size and strength of this grassroots team, so I’m humbly asking:**

This FEC deadline is our final opportunity before the primary for us to show that we have the support needed to win here in New Hampshire.
With your help our FEC report will prove that we have the support of everyday folks like you. Together we can prove that New Hampshire is not for sale.
_[**So, friend, what do you say? clean_body: | | | | Friend, I’m reaching out personally, because this Wednesday - on August 19th - our campaign will face our final FEC deadline before New Hampshire’s primary election. Look, friend, this deadline is different from our usual monthly and quarterly deadlines I’ve emailed you about before. And I want to tell you exactly why: Wednesday’s deadline marks the LAST time we’ll report our fundraising to the FEC before the primary election. That means it’s our LAST chance to prove we can defeat the MAGA billionaires who are dumping money into this race to try to buy the Granite State’s Senate seat. It’s no exaggeration to say this is the biggest test our campaign has faced so far. And our ability to keep New Hampshire’s Senate seat blue and flip control of the Senate will come down to whether we can raise enough to build a winning campaign. We need to take this opportunity to show the size and strength of this grassroots team, so I’m humbly asking: Right now Republicans are outspending us at a ratio of 3 to 1. They’re counting on us to be intimidated by their spending; they believe that flooding the airwaves will discourage our campaign from moving forward. This FEC deadline is our final opportunity before the primary for us to show that we have the support needed to win here in New Hampshire. With your help our FEC report will prove that we have the support of everyday folks like you. Together we can prove that New Hampshire is not for sale. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | Thank you for all that you do, Chris Pappas The Nevada State Democratic Party fights for progress in the Silver State. # We Have 4 Hours To the Deadline - I Will Match Your Donation TONIGHT.
Dear Friend, We have four hours left until the first fundraising deadline is over. Don't let this pass without [standing with us](https://us.list-manage.com/13eZjjQvyOj?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b), please.

We have a professional vendor standing by with the ability to reach 400,000 swing voters for us. We just need to raise the additional funds to cover this amazing initiative.

**And tonight I will match your donation**. Once again, I am putting our skin in the game again to show you how much we care for our State and to ask that you also step up and help us now.

| | Peter,
**It’s official. The ballots are counted, and I made it through the 12-way “jungle primary” to the general election for Washington’s 5th Congressional District.**
This was the largest primary field since the founding of our district. You chose me. I don’t take that lightly.
Before anything else, I want you to sit with one number: **47%.**
That’s how much of the vote incumbent Michael Baumgartner got. The only Republican in the race. With every advantage of the office, a massive fundraising edge he never had to work for, and not a single Republican splitting his vote.
**More than 52% of Eastern Washington voted for someone other than their own congressman. That is not a safe seat for the incumbent. That is a district looking for a change.**
**We have said from the beginning that Eastern Washington deserves more problem-solving, less politics. That the House representative should answer to the people of this district, not to party elites. On August 4th, a majority of Eastern Washington voters agreed.**
Now we have 60 days until ballots drop for the general election.
We’ll talk soon about exactly where this campaign stands and what it’s going to take. But for today: thank you. To the volunteers who knocked doors in 100-degree heat. To the donors who gave $5 when $5 wasn’t easy to give. To everyone who put a sign in their yard or window, showing neighbors their support when the field looked too crowded to clear. | | | | | | It feels like nobody is running for governor right now.
Mark's hearing that [Deb Haaland's people think they're up double digits](https://us.list-manage.com/RXDekGkNpwT?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e), and from what we can tell they're acting like it. In other news, credit card delinquencies are also back where they were during the Great Recession, which matters because every midterm comes down to the economy.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/XgS5ANBzPBC?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | 🏛️ **HAALAND'S CAMP THINKS THEY'RE UP DOUBLE DIGITS**
Mark has been saying for weeks that a quiet race is bad news, and this one has been very quiet.
He goes through what he's hearing about the mood inside her operation, the poll she sent out to thousands of donors, and why that poll probably raised her more money than it cost her.
Gregg Hull has Sandoval County. He's running out of time to introduce himself to the other 32, and nothing about this race gets louder on its own.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/Xh4cAIDgEyE?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | 💰 **CREDIT CARD DELINQUENCIES ARE BACK AT GREAT RECESSION LEVELS**
The New York Fed's numbers landed Tuesday, and they're bad enough that both parties are already building 2026 campaigns around them.
Scott Jennings went on CNN with his version of how Republicans should handle it. Mark agrees with roughly half of that, and the half he doesn't is the part worth hearing.
Krysty takes it somewhere else. Her mother never carried a balance in her life, and Krysty's argument about why has almost nothing to do with Washington and everything to do with what you're holding in your hand when you pay.

📰 **THE JOURNAL HANDED THE SNAP STORY TO AN INTERN**
The tagline at the bottom says the writer is an intern with a statewide fellowship program, which is fine, except the Journal ran the piece with Stansbury and two food bank employees as the only voices in it.
Mark spent about three minutes looking and came up with six things missing from that article, including why people actually came off the rolls and a nine-figure bill that New Mexico taxpayers could end up covering. He's not blaming the intern, and he's pretty clear about who he thinks should have caught it.
🎓 **IT ISN'T THE PROFESSORS. WSJ EXPLAINS WHERE CAMPUS SOCIALISM STARTS**
Lazy rivers, buses with no fare, a dining hall where nothing has a price on it. Four years of that, then a $200,000 bill and a job market that works nothing like it.
Krysty read a good chunk of the Wall Street Journal piece out loud on the show, and there's a comparison in there about the dining hall, one kid with three plates of pasta and another with a salad, that lands a lot harder than it sounds like it should.

name: Enoch for Congress
subject: We are trying not to be invisible!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer
body:
WE NEED TO GET OUR MESSAGE IN FRONT OF MORE VOTERS.

| | | | | |
---
| | | | [|
---](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=80bf6112a4&e=c6e7dff14c)
| | Hello Peter,

Dr. Enoch’s campaign is moving across Ohio’s 8th Congressional District — **knocking doors, meeting voters, attending community events, organizing volunteers, and building the grassroots operation we need to compete.** Now we need your help with the next critical phase:

# WE NEED TO GET OUR MESSAGE IN FRONT OF MORE VOTERS.
With Election Day getting closer, we need to dramatically increase our visibility across the district. That means investing in **large campaign signs in high-traffic locations and digital advertising that reaches voters where they spend their time online.** And we need the resources to do it.
## CAN YOU HELP US FUND THE NEXT PHASE OF THIS CAMPAIGN?
Every contribution helps us communicate with more voters.A contribution can help us:
* Purchase **large-format campaign signs** for high-visibility locations throughout OH-8
* Expand our **digital advertising** to reach targeted voters across the district
* Produce and distribute campaign literature
* Support canvassing, phone banking and voter outreach
* Promote upcoming events and opportunities for voters to meet Dr. Enoch

**We cannot afford to be invisible.**
Our opponent has the advantages of incumbency, name recognition, and an established fundraising network. We are building something different: **a grassroots campaign powered by people who believe Ohio's 8th Congressional District deserves better representation.**

### [Will you invest $25, $50, $100, $250 — or whatever you can afford — to help us get our message out?](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=981cab1dee&e=c6e7dff14c)

**DONATE TODAY:**
[ https://enochforcongress.com/donate-now/](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=36795c521c&e=c6e7dff14c)If you've already contributed, **thank you.** Your support is helping keep this campaign moving.
And if you can give again, this is an important time to do it.
* * *

[](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=8b0b96a942&e=c6e7dff14c)
# YARD SIGNS ARE IN!

We've heard from supporters across the district who want to show their support — and **our Vanessa Enoch for Congress yard signs have arrived!**
Putting a sign in your yard may seem like a small thing, but visibility matters.A yard sign tells your neighbors:
**There is a campaign happening. There is an alternative. There is a choice.**
### Request your FREE yard sign here:

[https://enochforcongress.com/product/free-yard-sign/](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=c4b1224366&e=c6e7dff14c)
After you request yours, encourage a neighbor, friend or family member in the district to request one too.
**Let's make support for this campaign visible throughout OH-8.**
* * *
[****](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=eb61bbea55&e=c6e7dff14c)
# COME MEET DR. ENOCH
We also have several opportunities coming up to meet Dr. Vanessa Enoch, talk about the issues, and get involved in the campaign.
## FROM CONVERSATION TO CONGRESS
### Meet & Greet Reception
**Tuesday, August 25, 2026**
**6:30 PM – 8:00 PM****Hummus & Pita**
7334 Tylers Corner Dr.
West Chester, OH 45069This is an opportunity for real conversation about the issues affecting our families and communities — and the solutions we need from Washington.**Real Conversations. Real Solutions. Real Impact.****RSVP:**
[https://campaignhq.app/rsvp/hummusandpita](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=c6aeee9857&e=c6e7dff14c)
* * *
[****](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=b464f1642d&e=c6e7dff14c)
## MEET THE CANDIDATE
### Major Minor Books and Such
**Thursday, August 27**
**7:00 PM – 8:30 PM**
_Doors open at 6:45 PM_**Major Minor Books and Such**
6718 Montgomery Rd.
Cincinnati, OH 45236
Come meet Dr. Enoch and hear about her priorities for Ohio's 8th Congressional District, including protecting Social Security and Medicare, lowering healthcare and prescription drug costs, strengthening veterans' services, creating jobs, expanding affordable housing, investing in American manufacturing, and holding government accountable.
Bring your questions — and bring a friend. [RSVP here](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=8c87c4927b&e=c6e7dff14c).
* * *
[](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=2f8ed229f0&e=c6e7dff14c)
## CANVASS GREENHILLS WITH US!
### Canvass for Jonathan Bradner & Dr. Vanessa Enoch
**Sunday, August 30**
**2:00 PM – 5:00 PM****Drummond St. & Damon Rd.**
99 Drummond Street
Greenhills, Ohio
The Cincinnati Working Families Party Wolf Pack is organizing a [canvass covering **Greenhills A, B and C. RSVP on Mobilize here.**](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=77ae4e498d&e=c6e7dff14c)
No canvassing experience is necessary. **Training will be provided.**
Bring a fully charged phone, comfortable walking shoes, and a friend.
* * *
# WE HAVE A LOT OF WORK TO DO — AND NOT A LOT OF TIME.
This campaign is growing.People are volunteering.People are requesting signs.People are attending events.People are knocking doors.And voters are beginning to hear our message.
**Now we need to scale.**
That requires resources.When you contribute to this campaign, you aren't simply making a donation. **You're helping us communicate with voters who may otherwise never hear about this race.**
You're helping us put up the signs.You're helping us run the ads.You're helping us print the literature.You're helping us knock the doors.You're helping us build the field operation.And ultimately, **you're helping give voters in Ohio's 8th Congressional District a real choice.**

### Please make a contribution today.

**DONATE:**
[ https://enochforcongress.com/donate-now/](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=36d3e8662c&e=c6e7dff14c)
**REQUEST A YARD SIGN:**
[ https://enochforcongress.com/product/free-yard-sign/](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=129a0a32f4&e=c6e7dff14c)
**VOLUNTEER:**
[ https://campaignhq.app](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=723812c585&e=c6e7dff14c)
[Whether you can give **$10, $25, $50, $100, $250 or more** , your contribution moves us closer to the resources we need to compete.](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=0cb7050300&e=c6e7dff14c)
**We can do this — but we have to do it together.** Thank you for believing in this campaign and in what we are working to build for Ohio's 8th Congressional District.
**Dr. Vanessa Enoch**
Democratic Nominee for Congress
Ohio's 8th Congressional District
**Enough of Excuses. It's Time for Results.****Real Leadership. Real Solutions. A Stronger Ohio.**
_Paid for by the Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer._

I don't agree with Speaker Mike Johnson very often. But he's right about one thing. When he came to Southwest Washington last month to raise money for my opponent, he told the room that Washington's 3rd District will decide who controls the House. He's right. There are only a handful of true toss-up seats in the country, and this is one of them. That's why the Speaker of the House came all the way to Southwest Washington to raise money for my opponent.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137485662/640981167/724950626?refcode=260818-agree-mj-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZWRiYjZiMC03MTliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Wxxui9GyRSFIjoXyj424-KMrTwIS5OOg9uCaH6HdNs0=)

And it's why national Republicans are prepared to spend even more before Election Day. They've done the math. They know how much this seat matters. So do I. I've won here twice by earning the support of people who don't always agree with me, but know I'll put Southwest Washington ahead of either political party. I don't take corporate PAC money. I don't answer to party leadership. And I'm not interested in becoming another reliable vote for whoever happens to be in charge in Washington, D.C. That's exactly the kind of representation national Republicans are spending millions to replace. Mike Johnson came here because Republicans believe winning this seat could keep them in control of the House. I think that's a pretty good reason for us to fight like hell to keep it. name: Tim Moore
subject: I joined Newsmax yesterday
disclaimer_text: paid for by Friends of Tim Moore
body:
Peter,

I've seen it too many times. A magistrate judge makes a reckless call, and a dangerous repeat offender walks right back out onto the streets — into your neighborhood, near your kids' school, back in the community they already victimized once.

That's not justice. That's a failure. And it's time somebody in Washington said so out loud.

Yesterday, I joined Newsmax to talk about my bill, the Judicial Accountability for Public Safety Act [https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-tim-moore/081826_news_moore/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=SA-Email&utm_campaign=08.18.26_News_Moore&utm_content=Link&recurring=true] — legislation that finally puts real accountability measures in place for magistrate judges whose decisions put public safety at risk. No more hiding behind the bench when a bad call gets somebody hurt.

I've spent my career fighting for law enforcement and the folks who play by the rules. This bill is a continuation of that fight, and I wanted you to hear it straight from me.

Take a few minutes and watch the interview [https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-tim-moore/081826_news_moore/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=SA-Email&utm_campaign=08.18.26_News_Moore&utm_content=Link&recurring=true] — I think you'll see exactly why this fight matters.

Social Security turned 91 the other day. My wife used to make fun of me for making every speech about Social Security. Is this a boring subject? Does anyone care about the budget anymore?
Once when I was campaigning, a veteran pressed his dog tag into my palm and told me never to break my promise to fight for Social Security. By his account, he had started paying into it when he was 12 years old. He never stopped working and was still employed as a church custodian when I met him. Now in his mid-70s, he said he couldn't retire.
I never found the budget to be boring after meeting people like him. He earned the dignity of a secure retirement, but our society isn't letting him have it. If we don't tackle the budget, he never will. The Social Security trustees now say that the program has only [6-8 years of solvency left](https://substack.com/redirect/68ca53b9-03b5-4306-99d7-48c933504f3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and if Social Security were to go away, [22 million additional people](https://substack.com/redirect/59693935-d8fd-45bb-b7a0-a8efb4970045?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) would be plunged into poverty. Those are pretty high stakes.
How did we get here? And what can we do about it? Here is the state of play:

name: George Moraitis for Congress
subject: Thank You For Everything
body:
We are forever grateful to our amazing supporters!
| | |
---
| | [](https://km78svhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001HCyl2NJB19pszRWKBA220LaVGxcOjbA_EyeG_BUIMP-OwBiFtPfYGa7gQs59MDblyCNYjTA4H3AZPhomaUlKduZtXaiODur6pur2CXRPQnQC66GGbOs3blzd9_XixwSHLnjK3nv_-hDhpfJXxWbhD4GOHMaNuQwA&c=PQRuz-KihTLNQ67GiByFhHnC7_FC0WS9UdPpDXKzCLFr156nWZ8RJg==&ch=2bZHT2fPNH5_2Sjq7vb--DtxNUpZVCPQowm1teU4KeZGiCZBAGQEAg==)
---
---
---
| Peter,
As you may have seen we came up short last night in my effort to represent our area in US Congress and former Boca Raton Mayor Scott Singer is the Republican nominee for Florida District 25 in November. Mayor Singer ran an excellent campaign and he and his team deserve credit for their victory. I was able to call to congratulate him last night and Mayor Singer was very gracious in his remarks to me. He also expressed his admiration for how we ran a positive campaign and even treated our opponents well in our hard fought effort to win. Mayor Singer is a family man, successful former Mayor of Boca Raton and a conservative Republican who shares many of my priorities in running for office to make our community more affordable while supporting President Trump's America First agenda in Washington. Heather and I have already contributed to Mayor Singer's campaign and I hope you will follow my example by contributing and volunteering to help his campaign in the November general election. This is an important seat for retaining the Republican majority in the US House and you can find more information about Mayor Singer's campaign at [SCOTT SINGER FOR CONGRESS](https://km78svhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001HCyl2NJB19pszRWKBA220LaVGxcOjbA_EyeG_BUIMP-OwBiFtPfYGUkF696n6UzZrMR4LBtobMG41JlrUQ7_bIn1Cw_AGuYz3wDZltaIUNAxXgHRjAXX-KUfJeU31rhazNucBQITndsIc5kSfAyagAiJUTU0fJbb&c=PQRuz-KihTLNQ67GiByFhHnC7_FC0WS9UdPpDXKzCLFr156nWZ8RJg==&ch=2bZHT2fPNH5_2Sjq7vb--DtxNUpZVCPQowm1teU4KeZGiCZBAGQEAg==) Thank you to all of our supporters and volunteers for your sacrifices in so many ways to help me in my run for US Congress. We raised a considerable amount of support and with our tireless volunteer efforts we came within just over 1000 votes of the victory despite being outraised financially by more than 2 to 1. I want to personally thank each of you for doing so much to help - so many of you gave sacrificially and spent numerous hours making calls, knocking on doors and engaging our community at the polls during voting. I most of all want to thank God for a great campaign and for each of you who supported me and volunteered for my campaign. As one of my supporters told me last night they are excited to see what God has next for me. I share their excitement and I am also excited to see what God has next for each of you who made this run possible. As the campaign comes to an end I also pray that you will take risks to do great things for our wonderful God, do your best and be surprised at how God can use you. Colossians 3:23-24, "And whatever you do, do it heartily, as to the Lord and not to men, knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ." clean_body: We are forever grateful to our amazing supporters! | | | | | == | Peter, As you may have seen we came up short last night in my effort to represent our area in US Congress and former Boca Raton Mayor Scott Singer is the Republican nominee for Florida District 25 in November. Mayor Singer ran an excellent campaign and he and his team deserve credit for their victory. I was able to call to congratulate him last night and Mayor Singer was very gracious in his remarks to me. He also expressed his admiration for how we ran a positive campaign and even treated our opponents well in our hard fought effort to win. Mayor Singer is a family man, successful former Mayor of Boca Raton and a conservative Republican who shares many of my priorities in running for office to make our community more affordable while supporting President Trump's America First agenda in Washington. Heather and I have already contributed to Mayor Singer's campaign and I hope you will follow my example by contributing and volunteering to help his campaign in the November general election. This is an important seat for retaining the Republican majority in the US House and you can find more information about Mayor Singer's campaign at == Thank you to all of our supporters and volunteers for your sacrifices in so many ways to help me in my run for US Congress. We raised a considerable amount of support and with our tireless volunteer efforts we came within just over 1000 votes of the victory despite being outraised financially by more than 2 to 1. I want to personally thank each of you for doing so much to help - so many of you gave sacrificially and spent numerous hours making calls, knocking on doors and engaging our community at the polls during voting. I most of all want to thank God for a great campaign and for each of you who supported me and volunteered for my campaign. As one of my supporters told me last night they are excited to see what God has next for me. I share their excitement and I am also excited to see what God has next for each of you who made this run possible. As the campaign comes to an end I also pray that you will take risks to do great things for our wonderful God, do your best and be surprised at how God can use you. Colossians 3:23-24, "And whatever you do, do it heartily, as to the Lord and not to men, knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ." Peter,
The Department of Justice has been busy under its new leader, Todd Blanche, Trump's former personal lawyer. But they haven't been fighting crime. On the contrary, the DOJ seems to be gearing up to commit crimes of its own.
Last month, Donald Trump gave a national address on elections where he floated completely made up data and reheated debunked conspiracies to lay the groundwork to use unconstitutional and highly illegal actions to challenge the results of the upcoming midterms.
Now, Todd Blanche is putting Trump's plan into motion. It was just announced the DOJ will be sending a record breaking one thousand election monitors to polling locations for the midterm elections.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001lgH_mfPi6QXsZoq6xtdAZzoxEzrFCVw6TeiX8GoTU7WPZfpdiXPpNFT4ZY5CAcMP-eWiv0l1HMBZGHlFETHvw8eP3LI1rEu5QdZzsbYJgGj7ZOzNcPch8veKggJ7zpIGWPdgEZt8662il2sBDv9YU9K3ejri4jNM-JriFlP3UkMRsGoRvLiEM8fs3A2sYU8g9Q46v6474Zz4rWguNaMYJdTSRCy2_Mq2CE_NwspFM64=&c=dRwN0mP4VXBt6s6sn8updU6WYlk9bEBkoYk6dOSqMadBGTDsq61jrg==&ch=BIo1Bnc7GX7xdSybj1wznKQtgu5ZM5dKWmn8_725XP_FvsWECVybfQ==)
---
There is no doubt what the Trump admin is intending with this move. The DOJ isn't sending a historic number of election monitors because voter fraud exists, it's because it doesn't. What they're hoping to catch isn't fraud, but any slip-up or honest mistake by a poll worker--any excuse, however small, to challenge an election's results.
And don't take it just from us. One state election official laid out to NPR earlier this month what this could look like in practice: a DOJ monitor finds a pretext to challenge a result, a friendly judge issues subpoenas the day after Election Day, agents show up at a county office in a close race, and walk out with the ballots "so we can count them."
This is exactly why Defend Our Courts exists. We're building a firewall of state Supreme Courts, the courts with ultimate say over election law in their states, and the last line of defense when Trump tries to steal an election in broad daylight.
There are only 77 days left until the midterm elections. We have to be prepared for the worst, and make this election too big to rig. But for us to fight at the scale this moment demands, we have to dramatically build our war chest, right now. And that means we need the help of Democrats everywhere today.

Now, Todd Blanche is putting Trump's plan into motion. It was just announced the DOJ will be sending a record breaking one thousand election monitors to polling locations for the midterm elections. | == There is no doubt what the Trump admin is intending with this move. The DOJ isn't sending a historic number of election monitors because voter fraud exists, it's because it doesn't. ## Trump Maps Hormuz as US Territory
President Trump escalated his claim to the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, posting a map that labels the waterway "new US territory" and announcing that no talks with Iran are taking place or scheduled. [See the post here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1qwzAUBeCnsbYE_Vm6HjQUird0KnQ0inQdq5UtI90ktE9f3Ffoeg58cM7HZbr4lNN2e_MrOprLtOGzZSTCOlG9r3vIPq1tKXW9_1Rf8VrK1yS5NCcOJzFMPlB64KQ9i25GlKgYOmHBCqUAgC0uguVqCCKq3ho0195q5OaKqLXWYuYsucPjIAbBudbmbMDCMFgIQc029rLTHGOiUs-fJW204Jy_ywPrOZSVZbcQ7a1TL50cOzlSvdPSSkg-H_0Ral7R59ey-Rzfj1GdHPfSqHVyFMIKYcQACgwH3kvFqov7M-WcmrGd5rfVpz-K0T8fejj5GwAA__9ABHju). Trump says the strait has been cleared of Iranian mines and is open, and that America already [controls the waterway](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2S3CAQhU-DMqb4GwkCAifK1qlDFYLWqm0QKuiZrfHpXRofYePueu9936-P5SNgxuPzZyjgaavLAV89AxG0hdqjnDEHLH2vrTz-ttBgrfXPooQaubBcuiVEwicsJgzJbwAK9ABeTnaSWltrh927GMBAgChjFKtOxknpokz6DqtL2zqgv_KElU4KYcx4G-1knZtsjHqb0l0xIyAh1Xb7XfGgHbb8qk9ot1jLkP1OdHamfzA1MzXTDjvmfN2Ymvda4EJiag6p4IGdWiCsB1PzKLSZ7pK_OflZO3VewslzWOFywq9fJF43_p-fh84fnRO0dq15MTUPzafzC3PGPk7MiM8S8N090Dd1Pr36FwAA__9zH43k) through its naval blockade. _"I like the idea of declaring it a territory,"_ he told reporters. The same day, a ship sailing out of the strait was [struck by an unknown projectile](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO3CAQhp8Gd6xgMAYXFGlQUtxVka60WBivyWFjAV4refrIm7zBNSONRpr__76Pt-nNxRS3x7tb0bQ5TxueNWFrWKZWjnX3ycW1Lrmsx5_iCt5z_pyAwUCZpnycnG_xiVPvumBmREDRoeFKKy6E1rpbjNQs9Hy8D8IHIdWIA-MB5H3WKngYZBfN9Y9pPnLG-n64DVrpcVTaezGrIIH0DENsudx-5bi1Bef0Oz-x3Hxeu2SW1vZKxDcCloA9z_N27PG6EbA_8z6941kJ2I9cUqD_lyuRgGWagOXX-FHcRusSd1r_GaFtKfl4LPT7i53WVlxs1LXm_CcGAlYyeYEyKUYNBGxXTNjPmFKsgyI9e6wuplfH9kW1TwN_AwAA__-iv4uV) that hit its engine room and resulted in one crew casualty, maritime monitors said. Only six ships crossed Monday.
## ABC Sues FCC in Fight over TV Licenses
Disney's ABC sued the Federal Communications Commission on Tuesday, asking a federal judge to [block an early review](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0Luu4yAYBOCnwZ0tLo6BgmIbd9l2SwvDT8wulwj-xMo-_ZHPK5xmmpG-kebPfbvbmGJ5_LYZDIa6FTh7AkRoG7ZXfrpkY-5Hbfn1v9kGe63_Nk75MlI1Mr1Zh_EN22wHbwIABzGAYVJJJoRSajiM1ovXjvLABF_ULnfq_A2sgF14HYIcork8qphmlM7zMi1KKq2lck4E6W-czBR8xNqmvzUWPCCkT31Dm1zNQzIH4rMT8YvwlfD1PM_Jld1dJeHrRRO-UkX4yq7wsRf4jHZ3Y4it42gzFJ-h4Jjs2V8Rx-DcdGBOQzP-ecaUYl8kmekj25i-R_GHX70N_woAAP__8O9-eg) of its eight largest broadcast licenses that the network calls retaliation for coverage the government objects to. The suit compiles a [timeline of President Trump's demands](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAQhZ8Gd6wM2GtcUGwUubtpUtzSGsOwOwk_FrC2kqePnFe43WiOzqej7_Nj_QAKlJ4_IKJpPq8JzxqwNSxrK--42wAU6yuX-P5boOCW8-9V9vLOe83FvIJtdOA6QOeMR5SoOjRi0pNQSmvdvQwI6yYcFWghthkEOrAzeGlH54UfoSNz8XotZtH3w3C_3fWk53nS1io_uVGyoUdHLZfbr0ypvdCHP_nAcrM5dsG8WtsrUw8mFyaX8zxvsaYrY3LBxN-VyWXPgRrZ63xe1RQxNSYX2Cyvb6z8evKtYHKQuIVSeOUFD8KTZ8-pVb6VDM5CbTyQxVTxgkHhj4eE9DkKppZsyTH1_dslFM_6E8veFeP2k0Kgep_Y0D8jUPg_vH3R92HkvwAAAP__CQiYyg) that ABC be punished, from late-night host Jimmy Kimmel's jokes to the network's refusal to air Trump's July address to the nation. ABC says the pressure is already changing what it airs. It livestreamed that July speech when it ordinarily would not have done so, and has stopped booking political candidates on _The View_. The FCC says the fight is about its yearlong probe into whether Disney's DEI practices broke discrimination rules, not speech. The agency last revoked a license over programming in 1969.
## Billionaires Buy Vaults in Swiss Alps
A Swiss family firm called Brunig Mega Safe started blasting into an alpine mountainside early this year, and by next year it plans to open [about 20 private vaults](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSpCAURb8GM7rgYQsGBJuY9aYbWoiP9u2gWIB29Xz9lDOfMMlN7q1Tt86_x_hwFGl7_nUr2hrSuOGrRKwV81jzse4-OlrLkvJ6fGaXcUrpYwQBHReGy350vtKJY-ua2QZEQNWgldpoqZQxplmsBj31Wvn77DsTQpDSK6Na1UPbiRl8Q_biCSN7KUTbdrfOaNP32nivgp7vwFqBM9WUb_8TbXXBEN_pxHzzaW2iXWrdC1N_GAwMhu29p1KvisFwgRkMwjAY5BXTUWjDUhgMtBWakdcFeXlRKdzFvfDTHbEWPiFtTz4dFCsPKf-sjh0zz-QXBkOT7by_KEYqnWateK6O4veh-kuPp4WvAAAA__-Xx4ff) more than 330 feet down, where the wealthy can stash gold, art, classic cars, and wine. Chairman Thomas Gasser is selling each cavern on a [99-year lease](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2O3iAUheHV4A7LvvgHCopkJHeTNqWF4WLfDIZPgG0lq49mtjDlaR4dvb_f13dDgeL-y5yoq09rxKcErBXzWvN1vmwwdJYj5fP6l03GLaWPFTqYeCd5r1ZjK924DqZx2iMCigZ1P8u5F0JK2RzaokIPg-uFdUaA2BwoAwbkOIK0TjakP71O9qrvumGY2knOUqlZWiv87EZgQ4eOasrtn0SxHujD33Rjbm06m6CPWl-FiR8MFgbL8zxteagUij619mCwYNwZLLfJlK7CYDH8xN3w7YofmLlPmdcDuSkFa-HJf61yvTDzTPbgVPiGFHe-XRQqN5VvmcH4JhiMP98ifeKql7MauqnJ2r0eCoHKNLOh209D4etn_WbeW8P_AAAA__-DEZAE) starting at 1 million Swiss francs, about $1.23 million, and buyers get a parcel number in the land register so they can even mortgage it. Gasser says security will rival the Swiss National Bank's, and he would not even show reporters where the entrance will be, only that drivers must stop at a checkpoint and leave their vehicles. Here's a [video report from German TV](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0MFOhDAUheGnKbshty3SdtGFicG4GKMr3ZHSXoZqoZNygYxPb8ZXcHtO8i3-j3N_djHF5fLqZrQ05n7BY01IhKWnss1Xn1yc1ymXefspruCQ83cvQLQn0Cdueucp7tg3rgp2RBQoK7RcacWl1FpXk22lC9I0chyEaQMYCNwFVAMHMwpAqKK9e6C54QBN09atVtoYpb2XowoPgjWAIVIu9VeOC004plvesdQ-z1WyE9F1ZfKRiY6J7jiO-pY32ga8__fFkZ-Y7HYmnz6Xbn_26u3y8l4VG65HTCmurWINXGYX0x9J_yyxW_EbAAD__0TmcvY) that shows the extent of the deep tunnel excavation. Residents in Lungern are split, with one grumbling that the village is building something for people who already have enough money, and others joking that Ferraris will soon be racing on its alpine roads.

Nearly four dozen Alabama school systems remain under federal desegregation orders decades after the landmark Lee v. Macon County case, with some cases still addressing racial disparities in student assignments, discipline, staffing and educational opportunities. Republican attorney general nominee Katherine Robertson supports ending the remaining orders, arguing they have outlived their purpose, while civil rights attorneys and others argue continued oversight is necessary to address ongoing disparities and discrimination.

# One Last Thought Until Next Week
---
| | |
---
If you check out Facebook this week, you can see the difference in how Mike Rogers and I see the world. Mike visited some businesses in Lee County and took staged photos with businesspeople, most of whom rely on government contracts or grants. Not spontaneous. Not open to the public.
Go back through his posts from the last 6 months (it won't take long). You'll see him in Calhoun and Lee Counties. That's about it.
On my feed, you'll see me at public events, handing out cards and talking with people. Nothing staged. Nothing scripted. Just me showing respect for the people of this district by asking what they need from their congressional representative.
And last week, we visited five of the eleven counties in the district. That's pretty typical for us.
Don't forget that our town hall meeting in Opelika is this Thursday. Bring some friends who aren't Democrats.
We're 77 days away from the general election.

We'll talk soon,

Lee

He said, "If it's lack of training or lack of clear directions, you can fix that. But if they aren't telling you the truth, that's an integrity issue, and it's a choice on their part... a very deliberate choice on their part, and that's all you need to know about them." Let's apply that standard to our Secretary of Defense, Pete Hegseth. Covering every lie he's told in office would take too long, so let's go over some of the lies he's told since the start of the war with Iran... | == | A Few Things to Think About | | | ALABAMA IN THE NEWS | 📰 == A stalled Senate Farm Bill could determine the future of rural broadband by deciding whether the USDA's ReConnect program becomes permanent and what internet speeds and communities qualify for funding. The House version sets lower speed standards, while the Senate proposal calls for faster service and broader eligibility, amid questions about whether ReConnect should continue alongside the $42.5 billion BEAD program. | 📰 == East Alabama Health will take over management and operational oversight of Medical Center Barbour in Eufaula beginning October 1, aiming to strengthen and preserve local healthcare services. The partnership reflects a broader trend of healthcare consolidation in Alabama and is intended to support the hospital's long-term sustainability and role in the community. | 📰 == Nearly four dozen Alabama school systems remain under federal desegregation orders decades after the landmark Lee v. Macon County case, with some cases still addressing racial disparities in student assignments, discipline, staffing and educational opportunities. Republican attorney general nominee Katherine Robertson supports ending the remaining orders, arguing they have outlived their purpose, while civil rights attorneys and others argue continued oversight is necessary to address ongoing disparities and discrimination. | A CALL TO ACTION | As we come down to the last three months, we need you to do four things: First, we need you to get the word out. This is a grassroots campaign which means we're going to rely heavily on you. Share our posts, talk to your friends, and show off those yard signs and bumper stickers. If you don't have a yard sign, email mailto:joinus@leemcinnis4alabama.comto let us know what county you're in, and we'll hook you up with the person in your county who has some. == == == | Second, we need to meet your friends. One asset we have in this campaign is a candidate who will meet with people and have a conversation. Sometimes those conversations can be tough, but they're always productive. Set up a group meeting either in person (which is great) or virtually (which is also great). Email mailto:joinus@leemcinnis4alabama.com to let us know where you are, and we'll work out the details with you. | | | Third, make a plan to vote. We don't know what is going to happen between now and November 3, but the best way to ensure a free and fair election is to show up in huge numbers. Once you have your plan, help your friends and neighbors plan to vote. | | | Fourth, donate to the campaign. You have all been incredibly generous financially, but we are entering the expense phase of this race. Barb and I haven't charged the campaign for gas, meals, or hotel rooms so that we could save money for these last 90 days. Without corporate or foreign-interest PAC money, we knew we would have to run a slim campaign, but now we have to start getting our name in front of a wider audience, and that will require capital. | | == | | One Last Thought Until Next Week | | | If you check out Facebook this week, you can see the difference in how Mike Rogers and I see the world. Mike visited some businesses in Lee County and took staged photos with businesspeople, most of whom rely on government contracts or grants. Not spontaneous. Not open to the public. Go back through his posts from the last 6 months (it won't take long). You'll see him in Calhoun and Lee Counties. That's about it. On my feed, you'll see me at public events, handing out cards and talking with people. Nothing staged. Nothing scripted. Just me showing respect for the people of this district by asking what they need from their congressional representative. And last week, we visited five of the eleven counties in the district. That's pretty typical for us. Don't forget that our town hall meeting in Opelika is this Thursday. Bring some friends who aren't Democrats. We're 77 days away from the general election. Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass recently released one of the cringiest political videos I have seen in a while.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/6c2de93c-0ad1-426e-b3dd-cab5edcc9b3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A local resident had posted a video complaining about a pothole. The video went viral, so Bass responded by showing up with city employees, work trucks, cameras, and an apparent plan to demonstrate that city government was listening.
There was only one problem.
A car was parked directly over the pothole.
The crew could not fix it. Bass showed up, stood around the blocked pothole, and then released the video anyway. The mayor's official account proudly told the resident, "We got you," even though the pothole remained exactly where it was.
The video went viral for all the wrong reasons.
Almost anybody watching it could see the incompetence. City government mobilized employees, trucks, communications staff, and a camera crew but failed to check whether the pothole was accessible before everybody arrived.
Then whatever gatekeeping process exists inside the mayor's office failed, too. Nobody stopped and said, "Maybe we shouldn't publish a video of ourselves not fixing the pothole."
It became a perfect little microcosm of government at its worst. It assembled a large group of people, produced a lot of activity, accomplished nothing, and then issued a public-relations video congratulating itself.
The intentions may have been good. The result was still fucking ridiculous.
But there is a reason Karen Bass is suddenly making videos like this.
**Zohran Mamdani changed political campaigning.**
* * *
## Mamdani Changed the Campaign Playbook
The rise of Zohran Mamdani has been incredible to watch.
He went from being a relatively unknown state assemblymember to the mayor of New York City, the largest city in the United States and one of the most important cities in the world.
He did not accomplish that purely through short-form videos. His campaign also built an enormous field organization with tens of thousands of volunteers knocking on doors and making calls. His victory came from combining online attention with actual organizing, fundraising, policy, and voter contact.
But his videos introduced him to millions of people and gave the entire campaign its personality.
They were funny, self-aware, relentlessly on message, and directly tailored to the way people consume information online. He used them to explain policies, introduce himself, mobilize volunteers, reach different communities, and occasionally make fun of himself.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/364e3623-c095-4299-b5ea-a48ae8db73dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
They looked good, but they were not just random content. Almost every video returned to the same basic message about affordability and the cost of living.
Mamdani understood the internet because he was already part of its culture. He understood the memes, references, editing styles, humor, music, and language. He was not an older politician asking a 24-year-old staffer to explain TikTok to him.
He was not trying to become online. **He was online.**
It probably also did not hurt that Mamdani grew up around performance and storytelling. His mother, Mira Nair, is an acclaimed filmmaker who directed movies including _Mississippi Masala_ , _Monsoon Wedding_ , and _The Namesake_. He grew up in a family that understood film, culture, performance, and how stories reach people.
Most politicians do not have that background.
Mamdani also has something that cannot be manufactured by an editing team. When it is time to say "action," he can flip a switch and become incredibly charismatic. He can speak to the camera as if he is talking to a friend he has known for 20 years.
Whether you agree with his politics or not, that is a real political talent.
We have seen this kind of transformation before.
Barack Obama's 2008 campaign did not invent social media, but it was one of the first presidential campaigns to make social networking and digital organizing central to its operation. His campaign used the internet not only for advertising, but also to raise money, recruit volunteers, organize communities, and communicate directly with supporters.
After Obama won, social media stopped being an optional campaign experiment. It became part of the basic toolkit.
People also started copying Obama himself. They copied his cadence, his pauses, his voice, and his style of speaking. Everybody wanted to sound like Barack Obama because the Barack Obama template had worked.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/e8111320-a978-4e07-9693-99875509513e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The problem was that most of those people were not Barack Obama.
Now everybody wants to be Zohran Mamdani.
The same problem has returned.
* * *
## You Cannot Copy and Paste Charisma
More and more mayors, governors, members of Congress, and candidates are trying to campaign in TikTok format.
Karen Bass is doing it. Chuck Schumer has tried it. Abdul El-Sayed has done everything from playful campaign videos to a _Blue 's Clues_ parody. Politicians across the ideological spectrum are producing short clips, scripted jokes, staged confrontations, thirst traps, memes, and supposedly relatable behind-the-scenes content.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/7143a418-e6b2-4fdf-b199-ecae40dcd5cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
They are all trying to capture the lightning that Mamdani put in a bottle.
It is not working for most of them.
The first problem is what we call **the performance face.**
When the camera turns on, most candidates stop acting like themselves. Their faces change. Their voices change. They suddenly become a carefully rehearsed version of what they think a normal person sounds like.
It feels fake because it is fake.
They look like someone reading a script while desperately trying to pretend they are not reading a script. Their communications team may have studied the latest trend and reproduced all the technical elements correctly, but the person in the video does not understand why the original worked.
Mamdani does not merely repeat internet culture. He lives inside it. When he is not following the culture, he is occasionally helping create it.
Other politicians are being handed memes by staffers five days after the meme was funny.
Some of these politicians are also genuinely unpleasant people, and video makes that obvious. They succeeded through fundraising, party relationships, policy knowledge, or years of working inside political institutions. None of that means they can look into a camera and connect with another human being.
That is not necessarily a character flaw. Some people are simply not performers.
But the attempt to manufacture charisma often produces something worse than boring. It produces cringe.
Abdul El-Sayed's videos are a useful example, although they also complicate my argument. His _Blue 's Clues_-style voting video was mocked after resurfacing online, but El-Sayed still won Michigan's Democratic Senate primary.
So an awkward video does not automatically destroy a candidate. It also does not prove the video helped him win.
That distinction is important. Viral mockery can create attention, but attention is not always persuasion. Sometimes people are just laughing at you.
* * *
## Internet Points Are Not Votes
Spencer Pratt may be the clearest recent example of the limits of social-media campaigning.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0d53431b-999e-4fc1-8f76-3a26d87f1c53?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Pratt entered the 2026 Los Angeles mayoral race with a massive online following and decades of experience as a reality television personality. He understood performance. His videos generated millions of views. His TikTok account had approximately 2.5 million followers and more than 92 million cumulative likes by the end of the primary.
He also raised millions of dollars.
Then he finished third.
Pratt received approximately 25.5% of the vote, behind Karen Bass and Nithya Raman, and failed to advance to the general election. An analysis of the race found that Pratt's enormous online reach did not translate into enough support among the voters who actually decided the primary. [TargetSmart's post-election analysis compared Pratt's massive digital audience with his third-place finish](https://substack.com/redirect/e672abbc-8a4c-4b31-9455-bb8dd9e6b069?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The internet helped him raise money, gain attention, and become a serious candidate. It did not win the election.
Kat Abughazaleh offers another example.
Abughazaleh entered the Democratic primary for Illinois' 9th Congressional District with a large online following and an established identity as a political influencer. She understood internet culture far better than most of the people running against her. Her campaign raised money, attracted national attention, and turned her into one of the most recognizable candidates in the race.
She still lost to Evanston Mayor Daniel Biss, who received about 29.6% of the vote to her 25.9%. Again, going viral is not the same as winning.
Internet points may translate into small-dollar donations. They may generate media coverage. They may help a candidate who was previously unknown become viable.
But the people liking, sharing, and commenting on a video may not live in the candidate's district. They may not be registered to vote. They may not know anything else about the campaign. They may not even like the candidate.
Some of them may be watching because the video is a train wreck.
The internet can giveth, and the internet can taketh away.
Karen Bass wanted to show that she was responding to a constituent and fixing a basic city problem. Instead, thousands of creators, commentators, and ordinary users took the video, ripped it apart, and turned it into evidence that she could not manage a pothole repair.
Once a politician posts something, the campaign no longer controls it.
* * *
## Politics Is Becoming Slopulism
The larger problem is not simply that politicians are bad at making videos.
The problem is what short-form video is doing to campaigns.
Political arguments are increasingly reduced to whatever can fit inside a 30-second or 60-second clip. Complicated policies become slogans. Every issue is flattened into one simple promise designed to survive the algorithm.
Freeze the rent.
Make the buses free.
Fix the pothole.
Lower the prices.
Regardless of the merits of any individual proposal, complicated questions about funding, implementation, legal authority, trade-offs, and unintended consequences rarely make it into the video.
The politician points at a problem, announces a solution, inserts a trending sound, and waits for the views.
Call it slopulism.

It is politics reduced to algorithm-friendly content. It is endless simplistic videos created in the hope that one of them goes viral. It rewards the person who can perform a solution more effectively than the person who can implement one.
That is really fucked up.
Campaigns have always involved performance. Candidates have always delivered rehearsed speeches, staged photo opportunities, kissed babies, visited diners, and pretended to enjoy county-fair food.
But I do not think political campaigning has ever been reduced to this level of simplicity and stupidity.
If this becomes the dominant way campaigns operate, we may end up selecting candidates based on their ability to make short-form videos. People who are serious, thoughtful, nuanced, and maybe a little boring could become less competitive because they cannot perform for the camera.
Some of those boring people might be better leaders.
They might understand government. They might be able to think through complicated problems. They might be willing to admit that a policy has costs, limitations, or trade-offs.
They might be able to fix the pothole without filming themselves standing beside it.
* * *
## Mamdani's Actual Lesson
Mamdani's victory does not prove that every politician needs to imitate Mamdani.
It proves that authenticity, clear messaging, digital communication, and actual organizing can reinforce one another when the right candidate brings them together.
His videos worked because they matched the person, the campaign, the message, and the political moment. They were part of a much larger operation that eventually mobilized an extraordinary number of volunteers and voters.
Copying the editing style without understanding the substance is not campaigning.
It is cosplay.
I do not think most lifelong politicians can suddenly transform themselves into charismatic, video-friendly personalities. They are not theater kids. They did not grow up around performance. They cannot simply turn on a camera and become someone else.
Maybe that is the one upside.
Maybe most of these imitations will fail because voters can still recognize when someone is faking it. Maybe online attention will continue helping candidates raise money and become known without completely replacing the parts of campaigning that require real organization, real voters, and an actual message.
Mamdani changed political campaigning, just as Obama did before him.
But the lesson is not that everybody should talk like Obama or make videos like Mamdani.
The lesson is that when a rare political talent changes the game, copying the surface of what worked is not the same as understanding why it worked.
And if all your video proves is that you brought an entire city crew to a pothole and still could not fix it, maybe do not post the fucking video.

I’ll be completely honest with you: asking for money is my least favorite part of this process. I would much rather be out on the trail, meeting voters and talking about our vision for a free society.
But I have to give you the harsh reality of where this race stands: [the latest polling shows me trailing my opponent, "Dr. Lockdown" Amy Acton, by just a single percentage point.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
This race is a razor-thin, dead-heat battle. And the other side is raising MILLIONS to flip Ohio this November. [I urgently need the help of every grassroots patriot reading this to retake the lead in this must-win race.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._HOFAPFhNpxpmB7RvuA)

If you don’t know my opponent, allow me to introduce you:
---
[](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._FA)
---
[Amy Acton is the ultimate socialist in sheep's clothing. She uses soft, bureaucratic language to disguise a deeply destructive agenda.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._LAo36TEX1GfsIf4Ag)
As Ohio’s Health Director during COVID-19, Amy Acton says she had to shut down *outdoor* county fairs because there was “no science for it.” But she was totally fine allowing crowd-packed BLM protests to roil the streets at the same time.
She wants you to forget that she is the architect of the devastating lockdowns that crushed Ohio’s small businesses and kept our kids out of classrooms. Behind the polite facade is the exact same radical Left agenda: [more government control, weaponized dependency, and an ideology rooted in envy and grievance.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
If she wins, Ohio becomes another testing ground for the radical Left's socialist policies - just look at Mamdani's New York and you’ll understand their blueprint for Ohio.
The only difference between Amy Acton and the Democrat Socialists elected in NY is that at least they’re honest about where they stand.
But if we win, we will abolish the state income tax, slash property taxes, protect our schools, and unleash unprecedented economic growth.
[The stakes could not be higher. This is one of the most consequential races in the entire country, and we can pull ahead – but I need America First Patriots in my corner today.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)

This is one of them.
This week, I authorized our campaign to begin placing a new major television ad, even though we haven't finished raising the money to cover the full buy.
I don't love taking that kind of financial risk. But after my opponent, billionaire Rick Jackson, reserved $87 million in television advertising, I knew sitting on the sidelines wasn't an option.

I'm betting he's wrong.
But only if we have the resources to fight back.
That's why I instructed my team to start locking in our own TV reservations. Every day we wait, ad inventory becomes more expensive, more limited, and more valuable. If we're going to compete, we have to claim our place on the air now--not months from now.
It's a big commitment for a grassroots campaign. But this campaign has never been built on billionaire checks.
It's been built by people giving what they can because they believe Georgia deserves a governor who will fight for working families--not another wealthy executive trying to buy public office.
Rick Jackson may have $87 million reserved.
We have each other.
If thousands of people step up today, we can fund these ads, compete on the airwaves, and prove that Georgia's governor isn't for sale.

For those in the Lower 48, mukluk telegraph is a saying we have in the Bush that basically amounts to gossip. It’s passing along a message through our conversations with one another, _which is the only way information can really spread in some parts of the Last Frontier!_ In a state as vast and rural as ours, there really is no other way to reach every Alaskan. That’s why it’s so important for us to travel to their communities and have those person-to-person conversations. There are 585,000 square miles in this state — bigger than Texas, California, and Montana combined. And we’re going to criss-cross it in its entirety. But to be honest with you, reaching every community will be expensive. More than 80% of our communities can only be reached by plane, boat, or snow machine. And when we are able to drive, gas up here costs much more than it does in most of the Lower 48! But we don’t have another option. clean_body: I looked at the numbers. Your file is empty. Let's fix that right now. | Patriot, I have spent thirty years reading voter data. I know what a healthy file looks like -- and I know what a gap looks like. Right now, your file has a gap. Here's why this matters more than you might think. When we sit down to build our Senate strategy for November, we go list by list, zip code by zip code. We look at who responded, what they care about, and where the intensity is. That data is how we decide where to fight, where to spend, and where to hold the line. Democrats are not leaving blank files. Their activists are filling out every survey, returning every call, and showing up at every meeting. They are building the most complete voter intelligence operation this party has ever run -- and they are doing it right now, while most conservatives are still enjoying their summer. This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcFq4zAQhp9GvtlII8V2Dj4EFLML25bdDeQoVGnqDMiWsKSWvP1SSPcBepz54Bvm_69P5slSoG15titOlLPx0ZsP3BD9PdY9xLsNuaYU92KAQ9_ysRVHY12hdzTKNn46gBjfxgYnMYyDUIJD39ymHseDHJ1wyFG8Cqmc4m-iVyAOwvfWNjR9-vgojgK4VNAJ6bntnUBQfHiVB6Z4Td4W7GjL5DG7GFOKgQq53MV9acJ0KyVlJk8MZgZzRld39N2NQsjeBuzQVwbz_5nBXG7YRn_PGe_t4zEm5-yY1ByO4_GZg4JfZ61f9Pn8l0Ffy2pyrLtDJnXaY07oCm3LA63oqa5MalwthcfS2TVZWjYm9ePWF4hbwa0wqX-c9OXlevp5Mb-H9nr5036l0eyTTx8UAuV-YIovn97OxbUp3yrofYJ_AQAA__9APqBP)

| | Dear Fellow American, Have you ever had to wait for a long time for something? Me too! Consider this... For twenty years, Penelope waited for her husband to return from the Trojan War. As the years passed, others told her to move on, but she refused. Despite sadness, uncertainty, pressure, and hardship, she remained faithful to her husband Odysseus. **Today, loyalty is often held cheaply. But Homer, the author, considered it essential.** And that is one of many reasons why _The Odyssey_ has endured for nearly three thousand years. More than an adventure story, _The Odyssey_ explores timeless questions about courage, loyalty, marriage, leadership, duty, and home--the very questions every generation must answer for itself. **In a culture that often encourages people to put themselves first, Penelope reminds us that loyalty, perseverance, and faithfulness still matter.** Those lessons are needed today as much as they were three thousand years ago. **That is why Hillsdale College is launching a new FREE online course on _The Odyssey_ **and a special educational initiative to share its timeless lessons with Americans nationwide. **Our goal is to place this story before at least 100,000 students, parents, teachers, and lifelong learners** and encourage them to think seriously about the virtues that sustain families, communities, and free society itself. **But we cannot do that without you.** **Will you help?** Your gift today will help more Americans encounter these truths through Hillsdale's educational outreach. Your gift can help introduce more students and families to these timeless lessons nationwide with your gift of $25, $50, $100, or even $200 or more. **Please make your best, tax-deductible gift today using this secure link:** [https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/the-odyssey-support](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcFq4zAQhp9GvtlII8V2Dj4EFLML25bdDeQoVGnqDMiWsKSWvP1SSPcBepz54Bvm_69P5slSoG15titOlLPx0ZsP3BD9PdY9xLsNuaYU92KAQ9_ysRVHY12hdzTKNn46gBjfxgYnMYyDUIJD39ymHseDHJ1wyFG8Cqmc4m-iVyAOwvfWNjR9-vgojgK4VNAJ6bntnUBQfHiVB6Z4Td4W7GjL5DG7GFOKgQq53MV9acJ0KyVlJk8MZgZzRld39N2NQsjeBuzQVwbz_5nBXG7YRn_PGe_t4zEm5-yY1ByO4_GZg4JfZ61f9Pn8l0Ffy2pyrLtDJnXaY07oCm3LA63oqa5MalwthcfS2TVZWjYm9ePWF4hbwa0wqX-c9OXlevp5Mb-H9nr5036l0eyTTx8UAuV-YIovn97OxbUp3yrofYJ_AQAA__9APqBP) Hillsdale does its work while refusing every penny of government funding--not even indirect funding through student grants and loans. That means this effort depends entirely on supporters like you. This initiative is about more than a story. It is about whether the next generation will continue to learn the virtues that make self-government possible. **By supporting this work, you can help thousands of Americans encounter powerful lessons on loyalty, courage, duty, and home.** Thank you for helping Hillsdale teach these permanent things to the next generation.

body:
Did you see this?
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=63%2E42639%2EIt32e5)
See this?
[](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-jul26.QmaR25&refcode=em260819&t=2&akid=63%2E42639%2EIt32e5)
A few weeks ago, Senator John Fetterman took time away from criticizing Democrats on Fox News to set up something called a Joint Fundraising Committee with Republican Senator Dave McCormick.
What is a Joint Fundraising Committee and what does it mean?
A Joint Fundraising Committee allows a collection of candidates to raise much larger than normal checks into one committee that can then be spent to help or defeat candidates.
Do you think John Fetterman and a Republican Senator set this up to spend money to help Democrats take back the House?
I do not.
Will they spend to try and beat me, the last Democrat in Pennsylvania who represents a battleground seat? It's certainly possible.
So I am coming to you with two requests.
First, take note of what Senator Fetterman has done here. I am not sure if it is unprecedented, but it is certainly uncommon.
Second, I need your help to fight back in case any of these larger than normal checks raised by both of them are spent to beat me.
**[Can I count on you to contribute $5, $50 or whatever you can afford to my campaign today? New Hampshire voters have an important choice to make on Tuesday, September 8th, and we want to make sure you know exactly who is standing up for the principles we believe in.

**Today, Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire is honored to announce our final round of primary endorsements.**

Every candidate we have endorsed has signed [The Pledge](https://us.list-manage.com/LzR9Uhi2jaZ?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70) and committed to the people they are running to represent to fight for limited government, constitutional freedoms, parental rights, and the values that have made New Hampshire the Live Free or Die State.

Make a plan to vote. Reach out to your neighbors. Share these candidates with your friends and family.

Most importantly, help make sure our Pledge Signers have the support they need to get through the primary and onto the November ballot.

**Help Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire get these champions over the finish line on Tuesday, September 8th, by making a generous grassroots donation at:**[ www.CitizensAllianceNH.org/donate](https://us.list-manage.com/SaISNq8yoNw?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70)

This is the final stretch, and we need all hands on deck.

If we want stronger representation in Concord, it starts with electing candidates who are willing to promise to fight for you, your families, and your wallets.

Let's get these Pledge Signers across the finish line.

LET’S WIN!

For New Hampshire,

body:
I am writing to you with a truly heavy heart today.

Friend,

I am writing to you today not as a politician, but as someone who is deeply, profoundly worried about the future of the country we love.

A new report just landed on my desk, and to be completely honest with you, it has shaken me to my core. I felt a heavy knot in my stomach as I read the details.

What we have been warning people about for months is no longer a distant threat. It is a reality. Right now.

The fabric of our nation is starting to unweave, and it is happening much faster than any of us feared. I cannot sit by and stay silent, but I also know I cannot face this storm alone.

Republican leadership told me that you are someone our country has always been able to count on in moments of crisis. That is why I am coming to you in this critical, heavy hour.

I'm not asking you to make a major decision right this second--I am just humbly asking you to take sixty seconds to read what I just wrote.

Dear Friend of Life, **500 women.** That is how many women facing unexpected pregnancies PreBorn! is working to reach by August 31. But 500 is not just a number. **It is 500 women who may be scared, overwhelmed, and unsure what to do next.** It is 500 mothers who may be worried about money, insurance, child care, or whether they can possibly have this baby. And it is 500 precious babies whose futures could be affected by what their mothers find when they go looking for answers. Today, that search often begins online. A frightened woman can reach for her phone, search for abortion, connect with an abortion provider, and obtain abortion pills without ever walking into an abortion facility. **Approximately 70% of abortions now happen through abortion pills.** And the abortion industry is spending heavily to make sure it reaches women in these critical moments. **[In fact, it can cost the abortion industry as little as $5 to get in front of a woman searching for abortion pills.](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckUGPnDAMhX9NuM0InBDIIYdVEe1l220P7TEywQNRIYmSQP9-xWpW6rk3v2frs_z869W8otucX77iTtqezqRsJnqERDiFVFzwidCulMtK3kAN8lb3t0YZtMWdZARWs7az5FCRbrq-a0TLhaxWbZFgUmKWAmHua6VqANU-lEVspGqnyukLV_eNanjTCnFXD9VQPz36nnjdqo6J-ogzFsp3G3ymdOK103kfrir4uw17tem1lJgZf2EwMhgXdzq_3GOiKaT3EQbjUzEY7Ur2dzgKgxFtXOse5Mb4mBkfXj69fbn05zcG0uIe0S2e8UFwUB1nII-ymxyOZInxIaaQI9ni_PJs7TS7Y2d8oB3d9jT_4Zw2f5jBF_KF8aH9CeZ7dxu-_bh9pFElPcc_bttcllcGy0V7P7X854dODX8DAAD__69En_Y)** Friend of Life, we cannot simply wait and hope she finds her way to a pregnancy clinic. **We need to reach her first.** PreBorn! is a Christian ministry dedicated to saving babies from abortion and seeing lives transformed through the gospel of Jesus Christ. Through our Virtual Care System, we can reach women looking online for answers and create opportunities for them to connect with a registered nurse who cares about both mother and baby. Instead of simply being offered abortion pills, she can be heard. Instead of facing her fears alone, she can receive compassionate support. And instead of believing abortion is her only way forward, she can be connected with a local PreBorn! Network Clinic where she can receive an ultrasound, see her baby, and discover another path forward. When welcomed, our nurses can also pray with these women and offer them the eternal hope of Jesus Christ. **That is what reaching 500 women really means.** Five hundred opportunities to put hope in the path of a mother before abortion becomes her answer. And right now, **you can help us reach one of them.**
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckUGPnDAMhX9NuM0InBDIIYdVEe1l220P7TEywQNRIYmSQP9-xWpW6rk3v2frs_z869W8otucX77iTtqezqRsJnqERDiFVFzwidCulMtK3kAN8lb3t0YZtMWdZARWs7az5FCRbrq-a0TLhaxWbZFgUmKWAmHua6VqANU-lEVspGqnyukLV_eNanjTCnFXD9VQPz36nnjdqo6J-ogzFsp3G3ymdOK103kfrir4uw17tem1lJgZf2EwMhgXdzq_3GOiKaT3EQbjUzEY7Ur2dzgKgxFtXOse5Mb4mBkfXj69fbn05zcG0uIe0S2e8UFwUB1nII-ymxyOZInxIaaQI9ni_PJs7TS7Y2d8oB3d9jT_4Zw2f5jBF_KF8aH9CeZ7dxu-_bh9pFElPcc_bttcllcGy0V7P7X854dODX8DAAD__69En_Y)

I sat down with Ben Meiselas on the MeidasTouch podcast to discuss recent polling, the effects of Trump's war in Iran and Harvey Lee West: a convicted child sex offender who my opponent, Michael Whatley, appointed to powerful leadership positions within the Republican Party.
We are facing a crucial election this November and I'm going to need your help to ensure we can leave a better country to our children, grandchildren and future generations.
You can listen to our full conversation below.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d6ab7f03-3b02-4744-bb03-fadb7bd4f3a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
