[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/3fc7faed-a170-4d23-a5ce-aa249f13c0c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
**Ben Meiselas:**_Now I want to bring in former North Carolina Governor Roy Cooper. Governor Cooper, great to see you. Governor Cooper running for the open Senate seat in North Carolina. I want to talk about a few things, but want to start by talking about some of the latest polling we 're seeing in the state on Donald Trump. Not just the very low approval numbers, but when you look, he's just getting crushed among independents, and he's been losing a massive part of his base as well._
_You 've been traveling the state, Governor, as part of this Senate race -- you know the state better than just about anybody there, given your background. Are you seeing something that's actually different this time, or are you noticing things now even more so than when you and I spoke a few months ago?_
**Gov. Cooper:**_Well, when the President and his administration promised that the cost of living would be their day one focus, people are saying, "Hey, they haven't done anything and in fact, they've made it worse." I think that's a reflection of why the numbers are so bad is that people are feeling it themselves._
_Their families are having to pay more utility costs and housing costs and rising grocery prices. And this war in Iran -- we weren't going to get into any foreign wars, and this war has no strategy. Alex, who is a military spouse, I talked with her. On the base, they're all concerned about spouses who've been deployed overseas. I'm deeply grateful to the men and women in uniform who step up to defend this country. But also the cost of this war -- not only in lives, but in the cost of gas, groceries and utilities that people are facing just simply because this war has dragged on so much longer than was promised._
_That frustration is building up. They recognize that Washington is broken. There 's hardly a political event I've been to this entire campaign where someone hasn't come up to me and said, "This is the first political event I've ever been to in my life." These are Democrats, Republicans and unaffiliated people who come to my events understanding that we've got a lot to do to make a better country for our children and grandchildren._
_And they 're there because they want to make a difference. They're there because they believe that we should have the checks and balances that the framers of the Constitution intended. And they want a focus on the cost of living and the fact that paychecks aren't keeping up with inflation. They want leaders who will get us out of this foreign war. And they want people in power who will pay attention to them and not to the billionaires and corporations that we're seeing time and time and time again from this administration. And I think all the corruption that is occurring throughout Washington DC -- they were going to drain the swamp, it's deeper than ever -- and people are frustrated with that as well._
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/3fc7faed-a170-4d23-a5ce-aa249f13c0c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Ben Meiselas:** _You mentioned when it comes to Trump 's unlawful and catastrophic war in Iran, this never-ending war with no strategy. I think you can kind of define this entire Trump administration -- I call it the Trump regime -- as no strategy with anything except how Donald Trump, and perhaps Kushner and Witkoff, and a small cadre of people, enrich themselves._
_But there 's no strategy of "okay, if we do tariffs on the world, are they going to respond with retaliation?"_
_And then when you see retaliation, then the United States is like, "Oh we are mad, how dare you retaliate?"_
_" Do you think everyone is just going to be okay?"_
_And then, similarly, with what we see with the catastrophic war in Iran -- it's the "fake deal" where Trump, whether it's delusional, whether it's just that he lies about everything. Probably both. You know, he just lies. Okay, we did a deal. And then people are like, "No, we didn't. We didn't do it. Stop freaking lying and saying the same thing. 90 deals in 90 days. Tariffs are making us rich."_
_And I think the people showing up to our events, even though they 're going to technically a political rally, I think what they like about you is that this is just life. This is life stuff. They see a guy in Trump in the Oval Office taking their money and lying, and they don't like it. And they want people who will fight against it._
**Gov. Cooper:**_I think that 's right. One thing they know is that my opponent, Michael Whatley, will do and say whatever this President tells him to do and say, regardless of whether it's good for the people of North Carolina. The president still has a lot of supporters in our state, but I think that, at the end of the day, are going to want an independent Senator who isn't afraid to stand up to him. And this is one of the reasons why we are in the place we are is that the Republican leadership in the legislative body hasn't stood up._
_We know that a lot of money is going to come into this state to try to defeat because they want to hold this seat. This has been a Republican seat for a long time and we haven 't elected a Democrat since 2008. Yeah we're a little ahead in the polls right now, but already almost $100 million in ads have already been bought and placed against me by these outside Republican groups. We expect a lot more. We expect a lot from Donald Trump's PAC._
_So we need people to help us. And people can go to[ roycooper.com](https://substack.com/redirect/2907f496-9c7b-4d81-95df-6079e52cb0fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and not only help us with financial contributions, but they can sign up to help us do so many things, to help get out the vote. Because I do believe turnout here is going to be a big issue, and if we turn out, we can put some checks and balances on this administration. Not only refocus on the cost of living, health care, and all the things affecting families, but we can take those first steps in making sure that we shore up our democracy, which is desperately needed right now._
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/3fc7faed-a170-4d23-a5ce-aa249f13c0c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Ben Meiselas:** _You 're running against a MAGA extremist puppet of Donald Trump, Michael Whatley. He ran the RNC before. If you take the politics out of it, I saw a recent ad in this political period right now about Michael Whatley that I didn't know. That he hired this guy named Harvey West, a convicted sexual predator. And I saw in the ad, you had a former North Carolina Supreme Court Justice in North Carolina, a former top sheriff in North Carolina, and others just saying, "Just look at that judgment."_
_Talk to us, for people in North Carolina, they probably know the story a little better. But for people outside, what 's going on there? Who did he hire?_
**Gov. Cooper:**_Michael Whatley claims to be tough on crime, and he 's attacking me on that issue -- when, in fact, I'm the only one in this race who has actually prosecuted violent criminals and worked to keep them behind bars. When Michael Whatley was chair of the North Carolina Republican Party, he appointed a guy named Harvey Lee West, who was convicted of molesting children, served six years in prison, and was on the sex offender registry. Yet, as chair of the North Carolina Republican Party, Michael Whatley appointed him to an important position because the guy could raise money._
_He held fundraisers, and a lot of Republicans at the time didn 't like it and, in fact, challenged him on it, saying "hey we can't have this in our party." Finally, this past June, this issue finally came to light publicly. The Republican Party has always been wrestling with this thing since Michael Whatley did it, but it's finally come to light and the Republican Party finally passed a resolution preventing someone like Harvey Lee West from being appointed to a position of power within the Republican Party._
_So that 's the kind of thing we're dealing with here -- people who pretend to be tough on crime yet, when it comes to politics, they want to protect people who are child predators. This is the same guy who hasn't demanded that Trump fully disclose the Epstein files. This is a guy who has other situations, where he's been in the Word of Faith Fellowship, a church that has been accused of having people who have abused children. This is the kind of person who is saying one thing and doing another. And I think, at the end of the day, people aren't going to want that._
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/3fc7faed-a170-4d23-a5ce-aa249f13c0c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Ben Meiselas:** _Governor, before we go, what 's your final message to the people of North Carolina about why they should elect you? As you've been touring the state and you've been hearing what the people are experiencing, what's your message to them? And we've got a broader base of course throughout the United States, and we have a big international audience as well that's looking at our country and saying, "What's going on guys? What's happening over there?" What's your final message to people watching this?_
**Gov. Cooper:** _There are too many people like Stephanie, who is a teacher in Wake County, who 's had to change the way she buys groceries because prices have gone through the roof, mainly affected by these tariffs. On the base, they're all concerned about spouses who've been deployed overseas. I'm deeply grateful to the men and women in uniform who step up to defend this country. But also the cost of this war -- not only in lives, but in the cost of gas, groceries and utilities that people are facing just simply because this war has dragged on so much longer than was promised. ---
| | [_Giving Today Helps Protect Free Speech Tomorrow_](https://elink20c.newsletter.joinjustthetruth.com/ss/c/u001.aSE7MLJKPC4fRFRT4vWcrtmjqWXXiGy3ViBVttvQSSvWAB_D7mt8tsJG2QXeFKdeUzkrjrahzYSBiWdQry8KyRtThO5P_nimMBPaQjxDKADw12QV25326xYXNps1RpZcmODmL-tJVpVnMKBI2AaekMCB5rsif8XGkfzf0pr0KjO8HVPZWomMCYl1cAnP2zLmTAVNg-BFXJCOxrDryJc91hfCesh6Aj3I4IOqg5TwQ9VEpR0kz4Ix85PA2gQ9o8McSPFY-LqvFtQj36K5uJ3Q2nyu1RTRZYKKh_h3n-36bwX0vFnxhXS39k8Vd2URTVHORqlzTmzOJVp0WyMXhW27KQ/4tb/giNnQAJ0Ta-b5WHPMOlKKw/h2/h001.ABNQbdoGH1xv9bccTWlRGUF6_huDa3zeVez10SnpYsY) Dear Fellow American,_The Babylon Bee_ has become the world's second-most popular satire website because of its funny content on all kinds of topics—from world news to housekeeping.The tagline says it all: “Fake news you can trust.”However, New Mexico is censoring The Bee's content. State legislators passed a bill restricting political speech that uses artificial intelligence, as The Bee frequently does to produce the images that illustrate its “fake news” stories. Under HB 182, the Bee would be forced to post a disclaimer reading, “This [media] has been manipulated or generated by artificial intelligence” on everything it publishes.| [Stop the Humor Police!](https://elink20c.newsletter.joinjustthetruth.com/ss/c/u001.aSE7MLJKPC4fRFRT4vWcrtmjqWXXiGy3ViBVttvQSSvWAB_D7mt8tsJG2QXeFKdeUzkrjrahzYSBiWdQry8KyRtThO5P_nimMBPaQjxDKADw12QV25326xYXNps1RpZcmODmL-tJVpVnMKBI2AaekMCB5rsif8XGkfzf0pr0KjO8HVPZWomMCYl1cAnP2zLmTAVNg-BFXJCOxrDryJc91hfCesh6Aj3I4IOqg5TwQ9VEpR0kz4Ix85PA2gQ9o8Mc4ByJNkonsuTvtj4rhMq80a0fe6yUEky0LeAUdXQplYngwd0r1WdQIKi19xcPCTiYJQPIVWT46JJpjJs53PtzUg/4tb/giNnQAJ0Ta-b5WHPMOlKKw/h3/h001.PDR6Jh11Yzjtq8IxYbOKeVYm4NKxOvEvFhV2NNnxU7Q)
---
If you recall, legislators in California and Hawaii passed laws similarly criminalizing The Bee's satirical speech. But those laws have already been struck down, thanks to friends like you who supported Alliance Defending Freedom's work when we defended the Bee in court.
Imagine being forced to say, “What I'm about to tell you isn't literally true” every time you tell a joke. It will go over about as well as a lead balloon—and that's what this law does. Even New Mexico's governor and attorney general questioned its constitutionality after legislators passed it.
They were right to do so, because this is a flagrant violation of constitutional rights. The U.S. Supreme Court has repeatedly confirmed that the First Amendment protects satirical speech, and therefore the government CANNOT censor it—regardless of whether it's spoken, written, or generated using AI.
**But you've got to hand it to the would-be censors: They won't take “no” for an answer.**
[Protect Your Right to Humor](https://elink20c.newsletter.joinjustthetruth.com/ss/c/u001.aSE7MLJKPC4fRFRT4vWcrtmjqWXXiGy3ViBVttvQSSvWAB_D7mt8tsJG2QXeFKdeUzkrjrahzYSBiWdQry8KyRtThO5P_nimMBPaQjxDKADw12QV25326xYXNps1RpZcmODmL-tJVpVnMKBI2AaekMCB5rsif8XGkfzf0pr0KjO8HVPZWomMCYl1cAnP2zLmTAVNg-BFXJCOxrDryJc91hfCesh6Aj3I4IOqg5TwQ9VEpR0kz4Ix85PA2gQ9o8Mc4ByJNkonsuTvtj4rhMq80cj7Va3qlqro1Gi4SN82sc3B-7fOC-YjOVhqbL7stvDw2rIhTDPZfJF84kxmvyTqcA/4tb/giNnQAJ0Ta-b5WHPMOlKKw/h4/h001.ra7IMO1v4zapRhae4-YOwrMWZobeOVpvXQljVT_MPYs)
---
So we're asking for your help as we sue a third state over this issue. HB 182 shreds the First Amendment by regulating speech based on content, viewpoint, and who is speaking. It also compels speech, silences dissent, and targets political speech—which requires the highest level of protection under the U.S. Constitution. If allowed to stand, this law will create a roadmap for even broader censorship nationwide.
Free speech is no laughing matter. Will you give to help defend The Babylon Bee as it fights for its right to be funny?
**Logan Spena**

clean_body: New Mexico law censors satire site | | | | August 19, 2026 | | Wednesday, August 19, 2026 | Estimated Read Time: 3 MinutesJust The TruthYour No-BS NewsletterDear Readers,Today's sponsored message comes from Alliance Defending Freedom, on their legal fight to defend The Babylon Bee's satirical free speech rights.Thank you for your consideration of our sponsors. The Just The Truth Team | | | | | | Dear Fellow American,The Babylon Bee has become the world's second-most popular satire website because of its funny content on all kinds of topics—from world news to housekeeping.The tagline says it all: “Fake news you can trust.”However, New Mexico is censoring The Bee's content. State legislators passed a bill restricting political speech that uses artificial intelligence, as The Bee frequently does to produce the images that illustrate its “fake news” stories. Under HB 182, the Bee would be forced to post a disclaimer reading, “This [media] has been manipulated or generated by artificial intelligence” on everything it publishes.| If you recall, legislators in California and Hawaii passed laws similarly criminalizing The Bee's satirical speech. But those laws have already been struck down, thanks to friends like you who supported Alliance Defending Freedom's work when we defended the Bee in court. Imagine being forced to say, “What I'm about to tell you isn't literally true” every time you tell a joke. It will go over about as well as a lead balloon—and that's what this law does. Even New Mexico's governor and attorney general questioned its constitutionality after legislators passed it. They were right to do so, because this is a flagrant violation of constitutional rights. The U.S. Supreme Court has repeatedly confirmed that the First Amendment protects satirical speech, and therefore the government CANNOT censor it—regardless of whether it's spoken, written, or generated using AI. But you've got to hand it to the would-be censors: They won't take “no” for an answer. So we're asking for your help as we sue a third state over this issue. HB 182 shreds the First Amendment by regulating speech based on content, viewpoint, and who is speaking. It also compels speech, silences dissent, and targets political speech—which requires the highest level of protection under the U.S. Constitution. If allowed to stand, this law will create a roadmap for even broader censorship nationwide. Free speech is no laughing matter. Will you give to help defend The Babylon Bee as it fights for its right to be funny? Logan Spena Legal Counsel Alliance Defending Freedom P.S. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | 220 Executive Orders in just one year. | And with nearly three full years left on the clock... name: Scott Wiener
subject: The No Kings Act, explained.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott WIENER FOR CONGRESS
body:
Why I named it that. | |

Peter,

People ask me why I named a bill the ‘No Kings Act.’

It's because a president who believes federal agents can break your constitutional rights with no consequence is not a president. **That's a king**.

Here is what the law is today: a masked federal agent can stop you, detain you, search your home, violate your rights - and in most cases you have no realistic way to hold them accountable in court. The immunity doctrine slams the door before your case is heard.

**The No Kings Act opens that door. It's the first law in the country to give people a path to justice when federal agents violate their constitutional rights. It passed the California Senate 30 - 10.**

It pairs with the law I already passed banning ICE and other officers from wearing masks to hide who they are. Trump's Department of Homeland Security demanded a veto on that one. We held, and it got signed.

I don't say this to brag. I say it because in 12 weeks the voters decide whether I get to keep doing it - and whether Congress gets one more member who writes bills instead of writing press releases.

body:
I’m writing to tell you WHY I’m doing it and WHAT is at stake.

| [](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
---
Hey, Peter - it’s Vivek Ramaswamy. **
**By now you probably know that I am running for Governor of Ohio. I’m writing to tell you WHY I’m doing it and WHAT is at stake. **
**President Trump’s decisive re-election was more than a political comeback — it was a national gut-check. A repudiation of the corrupt ruling class. A mandate to finally take back control of our country.
As someone who has stood shoulder-to-shoulder with President Trump, I know what it takes to win. And I know what it takes to lead.
[That's why I'm running for Governor of Ohio – to lead the charge in the Buckeye State and make it a model for conservative excellence.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._8HxUfPT1Py7i1eg)
---
| | [**DONATE $5 HERE** ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
---
| [**DONATE $15 HERE** ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
---
| [**DONATE $25 HERE** ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
---
| [**DONATE ANY AMOUNT** ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.-3Q9QNDtKxrTocwCZ3HB6w)
---
This isn't about me - it's about the kind of country we want to leave for our kids. My wife Apoorva and I are raising our three kids in Ohio, and I want to make sure they inherit a state that is strong, proud, and free.**
**But to do that, we need to shake things up. We need to tell the truth, even when it's hard. We need to support President Trump and his America First agenda. We need to overhaul our failing schools, restore our national identity, and reject the victimhood mentality that's holding us back.**
**We need to secure our elections, prosecute voter fraud, and gut the bureaucratic red tape that's strangling our economy. And we need to do it all with courage, conviction, and a commitment to the values that made America great.**
**That's why I'm asking for your support. Whether you live in Ohio or not, I need your help to take on the Democrat machine and the Deep State in November.
[So, I’m humbly asking you, will you make a contribution of any amount to my campaign right now?](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.-U5XCw)
---
| [DONATE ANY AMOUNT](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.--HJLzVGTMSKKODKgBbw)
---
This isn't just about winning an election - it's about sending a message. It's about showing the world that we're not afraid to stand up for what we believe in, even when it's hard. And it's about leaving a legacy that will outlast us all.**
**[So what do you say? Will you join me in this fight? Will you help me make Ohio the leader of America's revival?](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)**
**Let's do this.**
**Sincerely, Vivek Ramaswamy

Peter, ICE just made two moves I can’t stay quiet about. **They’re turning a shuttered prison in Hertford County into a 1,400-bed detention center — one of the biggest on the East Coast.** The state didn’t approve it. Governor Stein opposes it. And here’s why it matters: **[ICE’s own leaked data](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137520873/641065884/1970488861?refcode=AU_GWN_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260819_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZDlhZjg1OS1lMDliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gVL7Bp2T-xpID98-mk5l0x27UBgIU8oaeNgaphCh9LQ=&emci=54d4cfdd-6a9a-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&emdi=5d9af859-e09b-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ceid=28008880)** shows 73% of people booked into their custody this year had no criminal conviction. Only 5% had a violent one. This isn’t “the worst of the worst.” It’s fear-based political theater, and now they want to run it out of North Carolina. Then there’s this: **ICE is about to spend up to[$20 million on gloves that deliver electric shocks.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137520874/641065885/1383682587?refcode=AU_GWN_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260819_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZDlhZjg1OS1lMDliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gVL7Bp2T-xpID98-mk5l0x27UBgIU8oaeNgaphCh9LQ=&emci=54d4cfdd-6a9a-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&emdi=5d9af859-e09b-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ceid=28008880)** Grab someone’s wrist, press a button, they drop. A former NYPD chief who tested one said it buckled his knees. The maker sells it as a way to make people “compliant.” Think about who that gets used on. So here’s where I stand. When I’m District Attorney, the law will be applied evenly to everyone in Wake County. That includes federal agents. Nobody will get a free pass if they break state law. **[But I can’t build an office that answers to the people of Wake County without you. Can you chip in $25 today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137520875/641065886/703255683?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&amount=25&refcode=AU_GWN_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260819_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZDlhZjg1OS1lMDliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gVL7Bp2T-xpID98-mk5l0x27UBgIU8oaeNgaphCh9LQ=)** _If you've saved payment information with ActBlue, your donation will process immediately:_ **** | | **[DONATE $10 NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137520876/641065887/703255683?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=AU_GWN_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260819_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZDlhZjg1OS1lMDliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gVL7Bp2T-xpID98-mk5l0x27UBgIU8oaeNgaphCh9LQ=)**

| | | | Peter, Yesterday, the Trump administration officially advanced a plan to shred the 25-year-old Roadless Rule. With a single stroke, they are stripping protections from 45 million acres of pristine national forests, opening them to road construction and commercial logging. [**We’re calling on all those who love and want to protect our public lands to join us in fighting back by rushing an emergency $3 donation this morning >>>.**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/rD33THtilLjRXCAD7UDt7g~~/AAUS1hA~/aiBmQMY37ydRMUz2n15Bmgho3eKzlFpkMttOyNxRG4fs2siZwmSgPqZdE-PlAKICdSkpuCcrIUi4JJiqmi1_ii8iKRjkmXw064zmjQew2ow0fnfiY3n9H_vzjmKP3yoo1VpLM5yHaTaOxHHxQPs6p-uRefoLgs8Ibg9cfEvajLt1Jdp1G9eDDl8bPa9HfHVEv6vOh8Pq70Gs0CzrJEjOkGEKDjekkzsCGSoV_okyKFSX0z2YxokUXhPsf8tKEv2t) We are talking about nearly 30% of all national forest land in America—including 9 million acres in Alaska's Tongass National Forest—wiped out and handed directly to the timber lobby. Politicians cheering this corporate selloff, like Montana Governor Greg Gianforte, want you to believe this is an "emergency" measure to reduce wildfire risk. They are actually trying to convince you that the best way to save an untouched, old-growth forest is to clear-cut it and pave a road right through the middle. **It is a bald-faced lie.** Research shows that 85% of all wildfires are started by human activity. When you bulldoze a road into the deep backcountry, you aren't preventing fires—you are guaranteeing them by inviting in discarded cigarettes, sparks from heavy logging equipment, and highly flammable invasive grasses. Fire ecologists will tell you that fires in remote, roadless areas are actually smaller and less destructive. They don't want to stop forest fires. They want to boost commercial logging by 25%, **and they need your public lands to do it.** [**This is a five-alarm fire for our wild spaces. Will you chip in $3 today to our rapid-response war chest to help us launch an immediate counter-offensive?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/rD33THtilLjRXCAD7UDt7g~~/AAUS1hA~/aiBmQMY37ydRMUz2n15Bmgho3eKzlFpkMttOyNxRG4fs2siZwmSgPqZdE-PlAKICdSkpuCcrIUi4JJiqmi1_ii8iKRjkmXw064zmjQew2ow0fnfiY3n9H_vzjmKP3yoo1VpLM5yHaTaOxHHxQPs6p-uRefoLgs8Ibg9cfEvajLt1Jdp1G9eDDl8bPa9HfHVEv6vOh8Pq70Gs0CzrJEjOkGEKDjekkzsCGSoV_okyKFSX0z2YxokUXhPsf8tKEv2t) **[**DONATE »** ](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/_OERRe1Uxhnsb27HLW-CgA~~/AAUS1hA~/3GLwD3k5uE4Hi1jGVNy3RjlWes6b6xOGRL2UxaDmFKYaLSNHdl-LFN8j4sFGbWxnuyExVtxFpXuRqv6yzDzvIcEkZPIAN5NJNI7DcJ7L97bO82-1Sz8-sqVHely73WKIQ3wDHgx-wHTfvpwQuVmj_8nwUNN8YhjU1CxzXAVP0tf_gAlTz7xeBwdQF0ujHlpmHst58FuhcyVXFWIau_IryL8T7_Pzpwkhg4O8Hhnc9imXBfWpZHkemrs2homhtIqn) ** You take our land—we take your seat. ##### **AUGUST 19, 2026 | AMERICAN KITCHEN TABLE**
## **You showed up.**
Lake, Sumter, West Orange--you left your kitchen tables, you stood in line, you cast a vote that said _this matters_.
To the 1838 who voted for me--you gave me your voice. I carried it into the arena. And I will not set it down now.
**To the Foundation Builders** gathering materials and starting to build--thank you for your energy.
**To the Legacy Builders** tightening screws and holding steady--thank you for your structure.
**To the Heritage Builders** ensuring wisdom endures at every seat--thank you for your remembrance.
Three counties. 1838 Builders. One table the Fourth Branch will not harvest.
* * *
## **The Fourth Branch Presumes Consent**
Your consent was presumed. Your representatives surrendered it. They do not sit at your table. They harvest bounty before it arrives and vie for that which does.
The extraction varies. The measure is the same. And so is the demand.
**No rule without consent.** The bureaucrat writes the rule. You live with the consequence. No vote. No voice. No choice.
**No court without a peer.** The agency judges its own case. You stand before a referee who answers to the agency that wrote the rule.
**No seizure without the light of day.** They take in the dark. Your land. Your water. Your wealth. Your freedom. What they take, they must take in the open--where you see it, challenge it, stop it.
* * *
## **The Fight Continues**
I am a mother who counts costs, a whistleblower who has seen corruption, a farmer who fights for this land and water. I walked with you as a candidate. I walk with you now as a citizen fighting with the power of the pen.
American Kitchen Table is advocacy. It is opinion. It is journalism--the evidence that makes both credible. The water board meeting you could not attend. The regulation that just landed on your land. The agency rule written without your vote. And pieces like what I saw when I ran--the institutions that denied you access. The station that silenced your voice. The club that relented only after pressure. The dispatch will name them.

subject: I’m officially running in the general election for U.S. Senate in Alaska
body:
---
| [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-peltola-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260819_8677_fr&refcode2=8677_22930333_a3RDnQ&akid=8677%2E22930333%2Ea3RDnQ)
---
Derek —
My name is Mary Peltola, and after yesterday’s primary, I am officially running in the general election for United States Senate in Alaska.
I want to share with you why I made the decision to run — and to ask for your support as we begin the general election together.
But if you already understand how important this race and your support are, and you’re ready to join our fight for fish, family, and freedom, please use this button to split a contribution between my campaign for U.S. Senate and the DNC:
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-peltola-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260819_8677_fr&refcode2=8677_22930333_a3RDnQ&akid=8677%2E22930333%2Ea3RDnQ)**
Now here’s a bit more on how I came to this decision.
When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.
Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.
Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.
So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families.
And I've got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying nearly 20 bucks for a gallon of fuel. They don’t even believe us.
They're focused on their own wallets — not ours.
And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest.
It’s why our prices keep rising, all while the healthcare and services Alaskans rely on get gutted.
I'm done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home.
My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning.
But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption.
I'm running for Alaska's Senate seat because it is the fight for our future.
**This is going to be one of the closest and most consequential Senate races this year, and I cannot do this alone. There is only one way we’ll be able to flip this seat... and that is together.**
So I am asking:
[**Please split a contribution between the DNC and my campaign for the U.S. Senate today as we begin the general election. We are looking for a huge number of day one donors to get our general election campaign off to a strong start and put us in a position to win. No donation is too small. They will all add up fast to give us the resources we need to WIN in November in Alaska and beyond.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-peltola-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260819_8677_fr&refcode2=8677_22930333_a3RDnQ&akid=8677%2E22930333%2Ea3RDnQ)

"Eight."** **Not one. EIGHT.** So I tell her exactly what she is agreeing to. **These people are not registered. They have no ID. No license, no bill, no paperwork of any kind.** She does not blink. She does not hesitate. She says: **"You are the ID."** I said it back to her, just to be sure I had heard it right. **_I am the ID._** She agreed. [**Help me tear this open.**](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=540861b105c84df599a2508a089811de&_e=ci8vfg3TtoSdhnp66824IormsMCerQh_M5ZPOGbXoBkgs3WZ1y_amwtZcz8Wh6fY40bHEgBcGN-MmTu3VyDjJbzcrj5RMaS8ML1ZZZcaXhgcMAdlZrKRdEkHgmxkVldhJcyFB9fTz_pt05rMBtjAl4bKzQqYnmNYMqq1gpC7dgMNMY0CdViJEsPAulP-JoCwlwgwuM7rr3pj2KNLVsqvS80YVZTeEFDXo-TYz-lFpE2B4uQ7g3x2H5FxlkGjbQWJhFZ4WcME1w2FB38cfFYwXrg5fCf9WnJWZ0p1E6FF05SVbgY8DFe8vjIizjOZD4JVcPtTbIyKqqRnZHQtnU19sD_2cRypHeAgXgfvVB4TF5SQVotklMpFvWbdFKnpv-ybN1bwAYCcXcpcPvLs5AQiGMegsOywq_A00wIaU7nxLfFZkU2dYhF2RCP7X4klCOjit8TAxfR7DYHyKIjpaobKDVmVT3y8SEWK97lDUzePXdHSfDGGudoIJN7KMI0XW05QLMk1s6C_C1Fg-efKpYsUIzV4q9l4pYjGbjGfBJ3lvzMfW5NINKbNGYqCxuxucMCxMZ896-kQryjaJ1oKMf57SzJ5QgML-crLS2ZZ0IgvKDbseWyK7_HAngKd9Ov_Pks3T-O9wdN3sd4NUA0gAN3pGcHIIZVohVhAo7cpSkHtkBlu99Szs27lpLs_KU1XODve) That single sentence is the entire wall standing between a legitimate election and a fraudulent one. ## _Protectors of the pinyon pines!_
* * *
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_What’s a pinyon jay?_**
Birdwatchers from Oregon to New Mexico are sometimes lucky enough to catch a dazzling sight: A rowdy flock of pinyon jays, covered almost entirely in beautiful blue feathers!
#
Pinyon jays are colorful cousins to crows, members of the family Corvidae. These bright birds are highly social, flying close together in flocks throughout the pinyon-juniper woodlands they call home.
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_Where can they be found?_**
Pinyon jays congregate close to their favorite food source: the seeds of pinyon pines. From the Great Basin in Nevada to the arid mountains of New Mexico, these birds fly in search of tasty and nutritious pinyon pine seeds – individuals can hold as many as 40 at a time! As they save seeds to eat later, some are forgotten, which is the primary way pinyon pines spread their seeds and continue to reproduce.
#
This relationship between jays and pines makes the pinyon jay a keystone species, meaning its presence affects numerous other species in its ecosystem!
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_So what’s been happening?_**
The troubling truth is that pinyon jay populations are falling due to a variety of threats. Fewer pinyon pine seeds are growing because of climate stressors. Additionally, humans clear cut, thin and burn woodlands to accomplish numerous goals, including increased forage for livestock and a perceived reduction in fire risk. All of this and more is contributing to the decline of the pinyon jay.
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_How can I help?_**
Protection under the Endangered Species Act would help put pinyon jays on the path to recovery, as well as help many other animals that count on this keystone species. You can help by advocating for listing under the ESA, and by sharing what you know about the importance of pinyon jays to our Western wilds!
#

clean_body: This bird is one colorful keystone species! This bird is one colorful keystone species! | | | | | | | | Protectors of the pinyon pines! | | | | What’s a pinyon jay? Birdwatchers from Oregon to New Mexico are sometimes lucky enough to catch a dazzling sight: A rowdy flock of pinyon jays, covered almost entirely in beautiful blue feathers! Pinyon jays are colorful cousins to crows, members of the family Corvidae. These bright birds are highly social, flying close together in flocks throughout the pinyon-juniper woodlands they call home. | | | | Where can they be found? Pinyon jays congregate close to their favorite food source: the seeds of pinyon pines. From the Great Basin in Nevada to the arid mountains of New Mexico, these birds fly in search of tasty and nutritious pinyon pine seeds – individuals can hold as many as 40 at a time! As they save seeds to eat later, some are forgotten, which is the primary way pinyon pines spread their seeds and continue to reproduce. This relationship between jays and pines makes the pinyon jay a keystone species, meaning its presence affects numerous other species in its ecosystem! | | | | So what’s been happening? The troubling truth is that pinyon jay populations are falling due to a variety of threats. Fewer pinyon pine seeds are growing because of climate stressors. Additionally, humans clear cut, thin and burn woodlands to accomplish numerous goals, including increased forage for livestock and a perceived reduction in fire risk. All of this and more is contributing to the decline of the pinyon jay. | | | | How can I help? Protection under the Endangered Species Act would help put pinyon jays on the path to recovery, as well as help many other animals that count on this keystone species. You can help by advocating for listing under the ESA, and by sharing what you know about the importance of pinyon jays to our Western wilds! | | | | | | | Defenders of Wildlife 1130 17th Street NW • Washington, DC 20036 Photo Credit: Pinyon Jay © Christina M Selby

**Wednesday, August 19, 2026 -**_** ** Israel escalates its attacks on Gaza, killing 17, wounding 38 over the past 24 hours. Palestinian child dies of malnutrition in Gaza. Nearly 470 attacks on Palestinians in the West Bank in a week. Land seizures, settler attacks and detentions reported across the occupied West Bank. UN: Gaza remains world's deadliest place for aid workers in 2025 for third consecutive year. Israel announces probe into two high-profile Gaza massacres. United Arab Emirates halts all trade with Iran after accusing it of launching missiles. President Donald Trump calls Hormuz "New U.S. Territory." Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammed Bagher Ghalibaf visits Iraq, lauds "resistance." Pentagon considering Gulf drawdown. Vessel struck, "completely" disabled off of Mokha. Missile strikes in Yemen kill three, including a child, in Hodeidah. Israeli forces continue military activity, demolitions in southern Lebanon despite "ceasefire." Lebanese army chief: Israel keeps attacking even as army implements agreement. Hezbollah MP: Resistance will confront any Israeli move on Ali Al-Taher. Primary results from Florida, Alaska, Wyoming, and California. Florida Democratic Senate nominee Angie Nixon criticizes party leadership. Trump pauses new 50% Canada tariffs for three days, cites pending trade deal. Whistleblower alleges Trump antisemitism task force pressured universities despite lacking evidence. U.S. quietly deporting Mexican migrants to Guatemala, Honduras instead of Mexico. Minnesota Attorney General sues Texas Governor Abbott over refusal to extradite ICE agent. Trump administration moves to repeal Clinton-era "roadless rule." Liberia agrees to take up to 1,200 U.S. deportees over the next year. Trump administration issues more International Criminal Court sanctions. Bolivia arrests major Trump-linked right-wing operative over shooting of activist. Half of Venezuela's oil is being exported to the U.S. Pakistan will challenge Imran Khan ruling. Israel says strike on Syria intended to block Turkish military buildup. Zelenskyy fires senior aide amid corruption probe. Liberia agrees to accept up to 1,200 U.S. deportees. Iraqi resistance leader decries U.S. control over Iraq's oil money and airspace. South Korea says Trump military drill cuts may be pressure on Seoul over Iran war, investment._
**This is Drop Site Daily, our free news recap We send it Monday - Friday**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZHJvcHNpdGVuZXdzLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.NLa5gwE_9eccPlg8KdkRHtc3S5Ab56eQE8SZRybdmIo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=211874982)
* * *
# Palestine
* **Israel escalates its attacks on Gaza, killing 17, wounding 38 over the past 24 hours:**
* An Israeli strike on a seaside cafe on Tuesday killed seven Palestinians and wounded 14, with Al Jazeera confirming at least one child was among those killed.
* "We don't know what we're supposed to deal with anymore. Do we deal with the Israelis? Or the sun burning us inside the tents? Or the water--waking up at 6 a.m. to go get water? Or do we deal with the winter that is still coming, when we'll also suffer from the weather?" Eyewitness Abu Ahmed said.
* **Drop Site 's Mohamed Ahmed submitted video reports from the scene of the port attack, available [here](https://substack.com/redirect/43dee2f2-679c-47f8-8fd0-9380019d4475?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [here](https://substack.com/redirect/677de59d-af97-425d-9d8a-661ed2860b38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
* At least nine Palestinians were killed and 15 wounded on Wednesday in an Israeli airstrike on the Municipalities Police headquarters in Gaza City, according to Gaza's Interior Ministry. The strike hit during a busy time in the middle of day and close to a crowded municipal park.
* **[Footage](https://substack.com/redirect/e2829713-0817-4613-81e9-63d3c6fc637d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Drop Site contributor Mohamed Ahmed of the police building attack shows ambulances arriving as people rush to carry the dead and wounded, including a woman and a child.**
* "Every day we say, 'Tomorrow there's hope. There is still hope,' while the number of martyrs keeps rising. Let people feel for us. Yesterday, it was the port. Today, the municipal park, full of children. Every day, they take revenge on us," eyewitness Abu Al-Baha said.
* Separately, an earlier Israeli strike on a motorcycle in the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza killed one Palestinian.
* Gaza's Interior Ministry said Israeli attacks on the civil police force are meant to cripple the police and "spread chaos within Palestinian society.
* Hamas rejected the Israeli military's claim that resistance leaders were targeted as "baseless." The group said the attack, coming after recent meetings with mediators and "Board of Peace" member Jared Kushner aimed at advancing the ceasefire agreement, showed Netanyahu's government was deliberately seeking to undermine those efforts. Hamas called on mediators, particularly the Trump administration, to take immediate action to halt the escalation and pressure Israel to abide by the agreement.
* **Palestinian child dies of malnutrition in Gaza:** A Palestinian girl [died](https://substack.com/redirect/444d737a-edbd-4f9e-ad81-d797909b0070?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from severe malnutrition on Tuesday as Israel continues to restrict food and other necessities entering Gaza. Since the ceasefire began, Israel has allowed in only 35.3% of the minimum agreed aid deliveries, averaging 211.8 trucks daily against the required 600, a document shared by Palestinian authorities with mediators on Sunday showed.
* The IPC warns that 74,200 children in the Strip require treatment for acute malnutrition through April 2027, including more than 11,400 severe cases. Without sustained aid, nearly 1.9 million Palestinians could face acute food insecurity by December.
* **Nearly 470 attacks on Palestinians in the West Bank in a week:** Israeli forces and settlers conducted at least 467 attacks against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank in one week, [according](https://substack.com/redirect/6d111dc6-f740-4e6e-8d33-5cdb6e29b25b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the Palestinian prime minister's office. At least 75 Palestinian homes and structures were also demolished, the office said, calling the attacks "relentless escalation of violence, dispossession, and destruction."
* **Israel places Palestinian journalist Mohamed Awad under administrative detention:** Palestinian**** journalist and Drop Site contributor Mohamed Awad has been placed under administrative detention by Israeli authorities, according to journalist Mutassem Saqf Al-Hait. Awad was arrested from his home in the village of Beitunia, near Ramallah in the occupied West Bank, on August 12 by the Israeli military. Administrative detention is a legal mechanism that allows Israeli authorities to imprison Palestinians indefinitely without charge or trial.
* **Land seizures, settler attacks and detentions reported across the occupied West Bank:** Israeli forces [detained](https://substack.com/redirect/5b753592-d8e5-49a3-9172-55f9656cd1ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at least 30 Palestinians in raids across the occupied West Bank between Tuesday evening and Wednesday morning, according to the Palestinian Prisoners' Society, while Israeli authorities and settlers carried out land seizures, outpost expansion and the continued siege of Palestinian homes. The detainees included journalist Abdulrahman Hassan from Bethlehem, while Israeli forces separately arrested Palestinian Jerusalem Affairs Minister after raiding his home in Silwan.
* **Ramallah:** Israeli forces [shot](https://substack.com/redirect/ffc6f2ae-6a1e-473d-ac12-8813f410dcea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and critically wounded a Palestinian man during a Tuesday evening raid on Al-Amari refugee camp in Al-Bireh, in the central West Bank, according to the Palestinian Information Center. Israeli authorities [declared](https://substack.com/redirect/7c202cdb-1211-45f0-9610-8813bbe6240c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) approximately 1,152 dunams (285 acres) of land in Sinjil, Al-Lubban al-Sharqiya and Qaryut as "state property" to expand the Karmei Oz settlement, the Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission said.
* **Nablus** : For a second straight day, Israeli settlers blocked roads in Beit Imrin, northwest of Nablus, isolating families and cutting farmers off from their land, amid a push to build a new settlement outpost nearby. Settlers, backed by Israeli forces, also continued to besiege three Palestinian homes in the Ras Al-Ain area of Qusra for the 11th consecutive day.
* **Jenin** : Palestinian Ahmed Al-Hatnawi [told](https://substack.com/redirect/ce3b93d2-ac2b-44c3-8a0d-e2825030e2c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Radio Al-Shams that Israeli forces etched the number "44" on his forehead and arm after detaining him during a raid in Qabatiyah, Haaretz reported.
* "As if we were animals and beasts," he said, describing the practice as deliberate humiliation. Al-Hatnawi said Israeli forces took him to a makeshift interrogation site, questioned him for roughly two hours, and threatened him.
* **UN: Gaza remains world 's deadliest place for aid workers in 2025 for third consecutive year: **Gaza [remained](https://substack.com/redirect/56525529-0d6e-47f8-a18f-8bc77a0576d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the world's deadliest place for aid workers in 2025 for the third consecutive year, with 186 killed in Israeli attacks despite the ceasefire declared in October, according to the UN humanitarian office (OCHA) in a statement to mark World Humanitarian Day. 68% percent of those killed in Gaza died in aerial bombardments.
* Globally, 350 humanitarian workers were killed in 2025, the second-highest annual toll on record, while 907 aid workers were victims of violence. Sudan recorded a record 71 aid worker deaths.
* **Israel announces probe into two high profile Gaza massacres:** The Israeli military [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/aa092e03-631a-40ab-ab49-061ff38f8da0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Wednesday that it would launch criminal investigations into two high profile attacks in Gaza, including the killing of five-year-old Hind Rajab and six members of her family in January 2024, and the massacre of 15 Palestinian aid workers in southern Gaza in March 2025.
* The military said it would not launch criminal investigations into three other attacks that killed aid workers from World Central Kitchen and Doctors Without Borders. The decisions followed reviews by the Israeli military's fact-finding mechanism, which is officially tasked with examining exceptional operational incidents during wartime.
* In its statement, the Israeli military acknowledged for the first time that it opened fire on the vehicle carrying Hind Rajab and her family after previously denying involvement in the incident and falsely claiming that its forces were not present in the area. **[Watch](https://substack.com/redirect/ccc51da0-458b-46da-8c2b-4321397c54dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** **an in-depth investigation into the killing of Hind Rajab by Al Jazeera 's Fault Lines in "The Night Won't End."**
* An investigation by Forensic Architecture into the aid worker massacre found that Israeli soldiers fired nearly a thousand bullets during the attack and that a number of aid workers were executed by Israeli soldiers at point blank range. **Read Drop Site 's coverage [here](https://substack.com/redirect/5a6c62d8-86e4-4ec0-ad10-aa80d028aa1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.

# Iran
* **UAE halts all trade with Iran after accusing it of launching missiles:** Iranian air defenses detected two ballistic missiles launched from Iran, the first falling outside its territorial waters and the second within them, the UAE Defense Ministry [said](https://substack.com/redirect/b2a0047f-72d4-4bac-aa55-4ed51c058fb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Tuesday, with a phone alert warning residents of a "potential missile threat." The UAE Foreign Ministry then announced it was halting all trade, commercial exchanges, and financial transactions with Iran until further notice, citing regional escalation.
* Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei "completely rejected" the claim that it launched missiles targeting Emirati territory, calling it damaging to efforts to build regional trust.
* **Trump calls Hormuz "New U.S. Territory": **U.S. President Donald Trump [posted](https://substack.com/redirect/4b438df4-5e78-44b3-b79c-5f33b9cda85a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a map labeling the Strait of Hormuz "NEW U.S. Territory," and, in a separate post, said no talks with Iran are underway and that the U.S. naval blockade remains "in full force and effect."
* Trump also claimed Hormuz is "open and operating" and that all naval mines have been removed or detonated.
* Just three transits were recorded on August 16 and 10 crossings on August 17.
* Kpler said vessels continue using Iran's unilateral routing scheme, with none recorded through the conventional Hormuz traffic-separation system or southern Omani routes yesterday.
* Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf [said](https://substack.com/redirect/0589b266-115f-4a16-9225-25ef706e0d48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Tuesday that "until the United States implements its commitments under the memorandum, including lifting the blockade, releasing frozen assets, lifting oil sanctions, ending threats and military operations on all fronts, and the other agreed conditions, the strait will not reopen."
* **Ghalibaf visits Iraq, lauds "resistance":** Ghalibaf arrived in Iraq on Wednesday for a three-day visit.
* Speaking at the site where former General Qassem Soleimani was killed, Ghalibaf said, "Today's visit to Iraq is aimed at strengthening the new order in the region and accelerating mutual cooperation among all countries of the region, without the intervention of foreign powers."
* Referring to Iran-backed militias in Iraq, Ghalibaf added, "After years of experience in Iraq, the resistance has gone beyond the borders of the two countries and has become an influential force at the regional and global levels
* **Pentagon considering Gulf drawdown:** The Pentagon is assessing whether to [reduce](https://substack.com/redirect/1728539c-bc7d-4799-9286-20281cb0a923?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its Persian Gulf military presence after Iranian strikes exposed the vulnerability of Washington's regional base network, eight officials told The Washington Post on Tuesday.
* CENTCOM normally stations about 40,000 troops across nearly 20 sites. More than 200 U.S. facilities have been damaged or destroyed since U.S. and Israel launched war; strikes killed six troops in Kuwait and four in Jordan, while U.S. defenses burned through more than 1,000 Patriot and THAAD interceptors.
* Officials have considered shifting forces west toward Jordan, Israel, or Saudi Arabia's Red Sea coast.
* **Rubio talks with UAE national security official:** U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio [spoke](https://substack.com/redirect/6ef4b7ae-53af-4bd1-a43d-6576fcbbdcb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by phone Tuesday with UAE National Security Adviser Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed, discussing "regional security issues" including recent developments in Lebanon and the Strait of Hormuz, the State Department said in a statement.
* Rubio continued to call for "freedom of navigation" through the Strait, and urged further U.S.-UAE coordination against Iran and its allies.

# Yemen
* **Vessel struck, "completely" disabled off of Mokha: **A cargo ship was [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/39ff61a4-d296-4501-9327-05577a44a0a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by multiple unidentified projectiles about 40 nautical miles southeast of Mokha, Yemen, resulting in a "complete constructive loss" of the vessel, United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations said on Wednesday.
* The ship was unmanned at the time of the incident, local authorities said.
* **Missile strikes kill three, including a child, in Hodeidah:** Three civilians, including a child, were [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/37a7984e-eb91-4a78-9abd-09d4374c9a89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after two Ansarallah ballistic missiles reportedly struck Al-Khawkhah district in Yemen's southern Hodeidah province, the Saudi-backed and government-aligned National Resistance Forces said on Wednesday.

# Lebanon
* **Israeli forces continue military activity, demolitions in southern Lebanon despite "ceasefire":**
* Israeli warplanes [carried out](https://substack.com/redirect/d0987cb6-6d9c-4669-8325-eab664a4f8a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) strikes on multiple locations in southern Lebanon early Wednesday, according to Lebanese media. The strikes, according to the Lebanese outlet Al Mayadeen, targeted the important Ali Al-Tahir heights and the area of Kfar Rumman.
* In Nabatieh, two young men were [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/ef8a482a-1c52-405a-b22b-995381b1e8f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and others wounded when a suspicious object believed to be unexploded ordnance left from previous Israeli attacks detonated near the earthen berm between Mayfadoun and Zawtar Al-Sharqieh, Lebanon's National News Agency (NNA) reported.
* Israeli forces [conducted](https://substack.com/redirect/ff9fbe2d-80e3-4e7c-b626-39cbd574312f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) demolition operations Tuesday evening in Talousseh, Zawtar Sharqieh and Kounin, destroying several homes as attacks continued across southern Lebanon, L'Orient Today reported.
* Forces demolished a water reservoir supplying Mansouri, destroyed two three-story buildings in the village and demolished at least one building.
* **Lebanese army chief: Israel keeps attacking even as army implements agreement:** The Lebanese military continues carrying out its obligations under the U.S.-brokered framework agreement while Israeli forces continue their "attacks and violations," Lebanese Army commander Rodolphe Haykal [said](https://substack.com/redirect/de19642d-65e3-4b38-8927-fba94307a324?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) via NNA.
* Haykal made the remarks during a meeting with Edward Gabriel, president of the American Task Force for Lebanon.
* **Hezbollah MP: Resistance will confront any Israeli move on Ali Al-Taher:** Hezbollah Member of Parliament Hassan Ezzeddine [said](https://substack.com/redirect/4d38bf88-7424-42cd-a2d4-31d9ab748819?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the group would not abandon the Ali Al-Taher heights and would "confront any act of aggression" against the strategic position with all available capabilities, speaking to the Russian news outlet Sputnik.
* Israeli forces have been dropping explosives around the heights almost daily, amid reports Israel could be preparing a larger operation there.
* "Ali Al-Taher is one of the resistance's key positions," Ezzeddine said, adding that Iranian assistance would provide additional strength. "If assistance comes from Iran, that would be light upon light," he said. He suggested Iran, which has established deterrence against Israeli strikes on Beirut, may act if Israel acts against the strategic heights.

# U.S. News
* **Tuesday 's primary results:**
* State Rep.**Angie Nixon** defeated former Lt. Col. **Alex Vindman** in the Florida Democratic Senate Primary. Vindman**** had a significant fundraising advantage over Nixon, having raised $16.3 million to Nixon's $975,000 before the primary, but Nixon handily defeated him, receiving 56% of the vote in Tuesday night's primary. DSA-member Nixon will face GOP Sen. **Ashley Moody** in the November general election. In an interview with CNN following her victory, Nixon [said](https://substack.com/redirect/c1028e3d-a8ef-4a2a-b225-504b06d3d0d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Democratic leaders **Hakeem Jeffries** and **Chuck Schumer** should face scrutiny as too many "corporate-established Democrats" are beholden to companies rather than ordinary people.
* Rep. **Jared Moskowitz** defeated his DSA-backed opponent **Oliver Larkin** in the Democratic primary for Florida's 23rd congressional district. Moskowitz, one of the Democratic Party's more ardent supporters of Israel, used the occasion of his primary victory to taunt political streamer **Hasan Piker** , offering his "condolences" to Piker after the AP called the race.
* Rep. **Debbie Wasserman Schultz** won her primary in the redrawn 20th congressional district, defeating four Black opponents in the majority Black district.
* Rep. **Byron Donalds** easily won the Republican nomination in the Florida gubernatorial primary on Tuesday, and will face Democrat **David Jolly** in the November election to replace term-limited Republican Gov. **Ron DeSantis**.
* Republican Rep. **Cory Mills** , under investigation for sexual misconduct by the House Ethics Committee, lost to **Ryan Elijah** , a former local TV anchor, in Florida's 7th district. President Trump had endorsed Mills, making him the second Republican (after Tennessee Rep. **Andy Ogles**) to lose a primary with the president's endorsement. Elijah will face Democrat **Bale Dalton** , a former NASA official, in the November general election.
* Democratic Rep.**Mary Peltola** [holds](https://substack.com/redirect/93a196f0-ef11-4efa-9c5f-debb02916324?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a tentative, 2-point lead over GOP Sen. **Dan Sullivan** in Alaska's nonpartisan primary. Both are projected to advance to the November general election, in a race that could determine the control of the Senate.
* Progressive state Sen. **Aisha Wahab** [holds](https://substack.com/redirect/34201161-5c08-44a0-a0ce-5417ea3b4b34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a narrow lead over the moderate and AIPAC-backed public transit official **Melissa Hernandez** in the special primary to replace California Rep. **Eric Swalwell**. As of Wednesday morning, Wahab leads Hernandez by 2 percentage points, according to NBC News.
* **Eric Barlow** , a rancher and state senator, [defeated](https://substack.com/redirect/be688bda-2413-4f31-b584-abc9e69bddb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Trump-endorsed public education superintendent **Megan Degenfelder** in Wyoming's gubernatorial primary on Tuesday. His victory makes him nearly certain to win the general election in the deep-red state, where voters gave Trump his highest margin of victory in the 2024 presidential election.
* **Trump administration moves to repeal Clinton-era "roadless rule"**: The U.S. Forest Service [advanced](https://substack.com/redirect/65ecdccf-4d28-4073-8a87-5c9ca2f978f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a proposal Tuesday to repeal the 2001 "roadless rule," opening nearly 45 million acres of national forest wilderness to road construction and logging and eliminating protections that have stood for a quarter century, including for nine million undeveloped acres in Alaska's Tongass National Forest.
* Environmentalists have warned that the move endangers drinking water supplies and wildlife habitats, and ecologists told the New York Times that new roads could increase wildfire risk by bringing more human activity into previously undisturbed areas.
* The proposal, expected to be published in the Federal Register this week before a public comment period, follows Trump's push for a 25% increase in national forest logging and Rollins' prior declaration of an "emergency situation," which allowed the Forest Service to fast-track timber production by curtailing environmental review.
* **Trump pauses new 50% Canada tariffs for three days, cites pending trade deal** : President Donald Trump [said](https://substack.com/redirect/a7eebb97-c5ec-4b31-8d38-ace859e784ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Tuesday night he was pausing the 50% tariffs on Canadian goods for three days, saying on Truth Social that the U.S. and Canada "have a DEAL!" pending finalization, following talks with Canadian Prime Minister **Mark Carney**. The tariffs, which had been set to take effect early Wednesday under Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930, targeted goods including alcohol, hockey equipment, cement, and dairy products.
* **Whistleblower alleges Trump antisemitism task force pressured universities despite lacking evidence:** A whistleblower complaint from former DOJ civil rights attorney **Haley Van Erem** , made public by Rep. **Jamie Raskin** on Tuesday, [alleges](https://substack.com/redirect/4aa342b6-adf3-4028-ac63-41d66e696f26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Trump administration's antisemitism task force pursued "predetermined" outcomes against Harvard, Brown, and Columbia despite little evidence supporting systemic Title VI violations, overruling career attorneys who objected to the investigations.
* **U.S. quietly deporting Mexican migrants to Guatemala, Honduras instead of Mexico** : The Trump administration has been [sending](https://substack.com/redirect/cee2b84f-e088-4e86-a6ff-76a78d4e138e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) deportees from Mexico to Guatemala and Honduras rather than back to Mexico, despite Mexico's willingness to accept all its citizens, according to two Department of Homeland Security officials who spoke to CBS News on Tuesday.
* **Minnesota AG sues Texas Gov. Abbott over refusal to extradite ICE agent** : Minnesota Attorney General **Keith Ellison** [sued](https://substack.com/redirect/e4189549-7bbd-4ba1-b606-195a29206bb7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Texas Gov. **Greg Abbott on** Tuesday to compel the extradition of ICE agent **Christian Castro** , who faces Minnesota charges of assault and falsely reporting a crime in connection with the January shooting of **Julio Cesar Sosa-Celis**.
* Ellison warned Castro could be released from Texas custody as soon as August 26 under a 90-day detention limit and potentially flee to Mexico, where the lawsuit says he has discussed marrying a woman and buying a house.
