_An eyewitness watches the Negra Francisca boat burning on March 17, 2026 near the Galapagos Islands. Photo: Darwin Flores-Pico._
QUITO, Ecuador--In the hours after a mysterious attack on an Ecuadorian fishing boat near the Galapagos Islands on March 17, a drone registered to U.S. defense contractor Shield AI was hovering just 500 meters from the burning vessel, La Negra Francisca, according to a review of flight tracking data by Drop Site News. This represents the first known vehicle to arrive at the site of the strike.
The unattributed bombing of three Ecuadorian fishing boats in January and March, and the subsequent abduction and torture of 36 fishermen, was first [reported by Drop Site](https://substack.com/redirect/21653abc-5a98-47f5-ba52-5799b3b95e36?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in April. Last week, The Washington Post, building on Drop Site's [ongoing investigation](https://substack.com/redirect/c1cfb7e9-0ea7-4d68-942e-0b0f68e0c618?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), reported that the attacks were part of a covert CIA operation.
According to flight and vessel tracking data from Radar 24 and Global Fishing Watch, the drone was a [V-BAT model](https://substack.com/redirect/4e786c34-4a5c-49f1-996d-4d1fd348622f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), primarily used for intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance, but capable of carrying a weapons payload and switching its signal on and off to avoid detection.
The Shield AI drone matches the fishermen's descriptions of the drones that circled their boats before the bombing, and bears the same red and green lights eyewitnesses reported seeing as they photographed the explosion.
Shield AI did not respond to a request for comment.
The CEO of Shield AI, Brandon Tseng, has [publicly stated](https://substack.com/redirect/4da614a9-f9ed-4ec9-b201-7009073d88ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the U.S. Coast Guard and Navy are using V-BAT drones "to interdict and destroy billions of dollars' worth of drugs that were headed for the United States of America." In 2024, the U.S. Coast Guard signed a $198 million [contract](https://substack.com/redirect/b694df1c-3eac-41d8-84ca-b619e8b459cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with Shield AI for V-BAT drones; in April 2026, Shield AI announced it had received an [$800 million contract](https://substack.com/redirect/76ef4b79-61ef-4017-8c68-7a0361fe42bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for V-BAT drones from the U.S. Navy.
No drugs were found on any of the three fishing boats [investigated by Drop Site](https://substack.com/redirect/c1cfb7e9-0ea7-4d68-942e-0b0f68e0c618?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--the Negra Francisca, Don Maca, and Fiorella--all of which were searched and cleared by Ecuadorian coast guard personnel prior to the strikes.
Last month[, Drop Site published NASA thermal imagery consistent with an explosion](https://substack.com/redirect/c1cfb7e9-0ea7-4d68-942e-0b0f68e0c618?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at coordinates 1.5822°N, 87.6958W°, recorded at 1:02 p.m., the time fishermen say they were hit, and in the location where their transponder stopped broadcasting.
Tracking data suggests that the drone launched from a nearby boat on March 17, seven hours after the strike on La Negra Francisca and then circled near the site, its signal disappearing and reappearing. Ascending and descending patterns of movement indicate that the drone may have been landing on a boat and then resuming its flights.
Drop Site previously [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/c1cfb7e9-0ea7-4d68-942e-0b0f68e0c618?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that vessel tracking data showed a U.S. Coast Guard cutter leaving a Galapagos military base a day before the Negra Francisca bombing--despite claiming it only deployed the cutter as a post-incident rescue effort. The Coast Guard vessel's signal went dark and later appeared in Central American waters 24 hours before the fishermen were placed in El Salvador's custody.
Video recordings, taken by eyewitnesses to the bombing, show the U.S. Coast Guard patrolling in the aftermath of the airstrike. Drop Site asked the U.S. Coast Guard in June to account for the cutter's movements after its signal went dark. The Coast Guard responded that it "does not disclose cutter movements during law enforcement missions for operational security."
In June, the U.S. Coast Guard told [The Guardian](https://substack.com/redirect/f26e1a06-39cd-4273-b2b4-d5f3be918d6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) it deployed its Bertholf cutter for a search-and-rescue operation after receiving a Mayday alert, contradicting prior statements by the U.S. Southern Command, which oversees maritime operations in the Pacific, that it had no knowledge of any U.S. involvement in the incidents. To date, the U.S. Coast Guard has not acknowledged using drones in its purported rescue efforts.
The U.S. Coast Guard, U.S. Southern Command, and the Central Intelligence Agency did not respond to questions for this article.
While flight tracking data is recorded in UTC, dating the drone activity as March 18, in Galapagos time (UTC-06:00) both the strike and the subsequent drone activity occurred on March 17.

Shield AI, a San Diego-based defense contractor, builds fighter jets and drones powered and piloted by artificial intelligence. The company was founded in 2016 with [$1 million in seed funding](https://substack.com/redirect/0e6c840f-a9e2-451d-bf18-24d189afaaa6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from the[ Pentagon's Defense Innovation Unit](https://substack.com/redirect/336b2afc-11a1-4f7b-9ccb-bd713a62b029?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and[ the Naval Special Warfare Command](https://substack.com/redirect/2c5e785d-14a9-4979-8107-e6a675ec86da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The Israeli military has [reportedly](https://substack.com/redirect/aec804f6-3f7d-4bb5-910e-8bd6a957726a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) used the company's self-piloting drones for close quarters combat. V-BAT drones are also used by the [Ukrainian military](https://substack.com/redirect/91781467-81c2-4f86-8217-fbe6e35d0b75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to identify Russian targets, as part of larger drone strike operations.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/1610b6c6-9697-4b11-9fa9-5d2dde66fc24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
###### Video of the burning fishing boat La Negra Francisca, taken by Darwin Flores-Pico, after the March 17, 2026 attack.
Last week, the [New York Times](https://substack.com/redirect/2058727e-1bf8-453e-83aa-3b5e1562d90f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and the [Washington Post](https://substack.com/redirect/d496ce72-fa76-4732-85b0-fb3756b507fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) corroborated much of Drop Site's original investigation of the attacks. In addition, the Times reported that a patrol plane flew from a military base in El Salvador in the direction of the three boats prior to each of the attacks. The Post identified that plane as FENIX 701, a Cessna business jet equipped with surveillance equipment operating out of Ilopango International Airport, which served as a hub for CIA operations during the Contra War against the Sandinista government of Nicaragua. The plane is registered to a company with virtually no digital footprint that lists its address as a mailbox inside a Virginia UPS store.
The FENIX 701 stopped broadcasting its signal well before reaching any of the boats and returned to base hours before the actual strikes, according to flight data.
The fishermen, like the airplane, eventually wound up in El Salvador. As Drop Site previously [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/21653abc-5a98-47f5-ba52-5799b3b95e36?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), men from the Negra Francisca and Don Maca boats were taken hostage by "gringo" gunmen in U.S. military uniforms who they say hooded, handcuffed, and starved them for eight days aboard their U.S.-flagged ship before turning them over to El Salvador's navy hundreds of miles away from home.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/57ed677f-e974-412a-bb31-12917095bd31?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Graphic: Tomi McCluskey
Since September 2025, the U.S. military has carried out over 66 strikes on vessels in the Caribbean and the eastern Pacific, killing at least 221, as part of Operation Southern Spear. The Trump administration has been boastful and unapologetic about this extrajudicial killing spree, which raises the question of why it would also run a covert CIA operation alongside it, as the Washington Post reported. There is precedent for such parallel operations, however. In April, for example, it was revealed that CIA agents were secretly working joint counter-narcotics raids with local agents in Mexico's Chihuahua state without informing President Claudia Sheinbaum--despite her administration's bilateral efforts with U.S. forces.
"We certainly do have cases in which one part of the U.S. government is doing something covertly while another part is doing something overtly," Vincent Bevins, author of "The Jakarta Method _,_ "__ a historical examination of the CIA's Cold War operations, and editor of [North South Notes](https://substack.com/redirect/3411c908-63a9-44e7-a9d5-cb6d89dbf4f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), told Drop Site.
"That covert operation might be doing the same thing in a different way. It might be doing something similar and related," Bevins added. "Even, at cross purposes, to some extent, with the official government line or official government policy....There are also cases where the only explanation is institutional chaos or poor planning."
## **A Community Under Siege**
In June, Alexandra Bravo, a prosecutor investigating the U.S. strikes, was [shot dead](https://substack.com/redirect/c1cfb7e9-0ea7-4d68-942e-0b0f68e0c618?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the coastal city of Manta, the home port of the three fishing boats. U.S. troops have been deployed in Manta since December 2025, and the return of a de facto U.S. military base there--originally outlawed by the 2007 constitution and again ratified by 60% of Ecuadorian voters last November--evokes painful memories for residents who have not forgotten why it was banned in the first place: the U.S. publicly and brazenly [sinking fishing ships off](https://substack.com/redirect/fe7a1077-5254-47d6-9b1f-2fc54acbef3f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the coast of Manta.
Ecuador is under its 23rd [martial law decree](https://substack.com/redirect/c6247c06-0dc4-4c14-9846-15ae574ff06e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which allows authorities to raid homes and wiretap communications without a warrant, and grants diplomatic immunity to all U.S. forces. President Daniel Noboa justifies the stripping of civil liberties as a necessary part of his "war on narcos."
The strikes and subsequent abductions left Jordi Flores, a young crewmember aboard the Negra Francisca, with a severe foot injury and unable to work. Erik Coello, a crewmember aboard the Don Maca, which was also struck in March, suffers from 70% vision loss. And the families of the Fiorella, which vanished in January, have been crushed by grief for their missing sons, husbands, and fathers.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b5f85f3f-1134-41dd-b9d9-fdb537e811a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Photo of Jordi Flores' foot injury from the March 17 attack on the fishing boat La Negra Franscisca. Photo: Hernan Flores.
Maria Mero, whose husband Gabriel Aladino Mero Delgado and brother Jefferson Ariel Mero Cueva both disappeared on the Fiorella, told Drop Site that her mother-in-law died awaiting her son's return, falling into a deep depression and ceasing to eat in the weeks leading up to her death. Maria's young daughter was hospitalized from the anxiety of going seven months without seeing her father. Gabriel's disappearance also left a void in the family's finances. Without him, Maria said, the ordinary necessities of life--groceries, her electricity bill, their daughter's school uniform--are completely unaffordable.
"If the CIA or the United States or the El Salvador patrol or the president is reading this," Maria said, "please, I beg you, return my husband, my brother, and all the people who are with them."

Peter, it's getting down to the wire here in PA-07. Here are the top 3 things you need to know about this race right now:
1. **PA-07 is the #1 tossup seat in one of the most important battleground states.** In 2024, this seat went to Republicans by just _4,062 votes_. That's one single percentage point.

Only 28% of Americans still trust the news. _Let that sink in._ **Nearly three out of four of your fellow Americans** have looked at the media establishment -- the anchors, the networks, the headlines -- and decided they can't believe a word of it. _And they're right._ A small circle of liberal media giants controls most of what America watches, reads, and scrolls through. **Just two broadcasting companies alone pipe their version of reality into nearly 80% of American living rooms.** These powerful liberal-bias machines decide for YOUR town what leads the local news, what gets buried, and what never airs at all -- and they do it without apology, without accountability, and without ever setting foot in your community. This isn't an accident, Friend. Dear Friend,

CNBC just named the "best place to live in America" - and for the fifth year in a row, _it 's Vermont_.

Their reasoning? **Vermont was the first state in the nation to enshrine abortion in its constitution, and CNBC gave it a perfect score, listing zero weaknesses.**

Minnesota came in at number four, and **CNBC praised Gov. Tim Walz (D)** for enshrining abortion into state law with his so-called "Protect Reproductive Options Act."

What they left out: Walz's long record of letting babies born alive after botched abortions be left to die.

You can't make this stuff up! And it just goes to show why our work at Students for Life Action is needed now more than ever before.

A daunting new report just confirmed my worst fears.

Friend,

I am writing to you today not as a politician, but as someone who is deeply, profoundly worried about the future of the country we love.

A new report just landed on my desk, and to be completely honest with you, it has shaken me to my core. I felt a heavy knot in my stomach as I read the details.

What we have been warning people about for months is no longer a distant threat. It is a reality. Right now.

The fabric of our nation is starting to unweave, and it is happening much faster than any of us feared. I cannot sit by and stay silent, but I also know I cannot face this storm alone.

Republican leadership told me that you are someone our country has always been able to count on in moments of crisis. That is why I am coming to you in this critical, heavy hour.

I'm not asking you to make a major decision right this second--I am just humbly asking you to take sixty seconds to read what I just wrote.

_**Contributions Made by an Individual or Federal Non-Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Individuals or federal non-multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $322,100. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $7,000, designating up to $3,500 to the primary election and up to $3,500 to the general election, provided such limits apply.

3\. NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $44,300 annually.

_**Contributions Made by a Federal Multicandidate Political Committee:**_

1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $10,000, designating up to $5,000 to the primary election and up to $5,000 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3 .NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $15,000 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5 .NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

Contributions to Team Nunn, or to any participating Committee individually, are not deductible as charitable donations for federal income tax purposes. Contributions from corporations, labor organizations, national banks, federal government contractors, foreign nationals without green cards, and other federally impermissible sources are prohibited. Contributions that exceed a donor's contribution limit to a participating Committee shall be reallocated to the remaining Committees according to this allocation formula to the extent permitted by FECA. Any contributor may designate his or her contribution to a specific participant Committee to the extent permitted by FECA. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. name: Tim Burchett
subject: I reckon I’m still aggravating them
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Burchett for Congress
body:
If you want to keep a Tennessee loudmouth in Congress who still thinks you should have a say in how this country is run, I’d appreciate your help today.

| [](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._7asFw)
---
Serving in Congress is a little like volunteering to referee a food fight. Somebody’s always hollering, nobody’s listening, and somehow you end up with mustard on your shirt.
Then I get back home and remember why I signed up for this in the first place.
Somebody stops me at the grocery store. Somebody hollers at me across a parking lot. Somebody catches me at Waffle House and says, [“Tim, whatever you do, don’t let those people up there turn you into one of them.”](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.-Q7g)
That’ll straighten you right out.
Because I didn’t go to Washington to learn which fork goes with the salad.
I didn’t go to get invited to fancy dinners, slap backs with lobbyists, or become another polished-up swamp creature who knows exactly when to smile and keep his mouth shut.
I went there to represent folks who work hard, pay their taxes, raise their families, and can smell a load of manure before Washington finishes putting a bow on it.
And with the midterm elections almost here, my Democrat opponent would be plenty happy to take my place. And I reckon a lot of people in Washington would be happy about that too.
They could finally get somebody who doesn’t ask so many uncomfortable questions. Somebody who knows when to nod politely. Somebody who won’t point out that the emperor is running around in his underwear.
Well, that ain’t me.
[If you want to keep a Tennessee loudmouth in Congress who still thinks regular folks ought to have a say in how this country is run, I’d sure appreciate your help today.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.)
---
| [CHIP IN TODAY](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.-uVFIEwN9a1hhD4K6u6w)
---
I don’t expect everybody to give, Peter.
[But if you can pitch in a few bucks and help me stay exactly as I am now, I’d be very grateful.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.-ZFoJmhl0S00dYJPJlGWQ)

body:
My thoughts on the state of the country and how we move forward
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137534773/641104251/-1038038363?refcode=ITT_ATA_EM_Share_FaceTheNation_260819_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjVhMjdmYjItZjU5Yi1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAwZDNhMTFmYTMwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Pevgnf3bQ0cNF1ydkV6Twvr9xs26MXLAXUpOh43YOlM=&emci=609dd2e4-399b-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&emdi=65a27fb2-f59b-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ceid=17458827)
Peter, we’ve got to fix the darn country.

I don’t have to tell you that people are struggling right now. The cost of everything from groceries to gas to a doctor’s visit is too high. Folks are looking for commonsense leaders who will actually deliver results and work to improve their lives.

This weekend, I got the chance to sit down with CBS’ _Face the Nation_ and share my thoughts on the state of the country, and how we move toward, together.

# **[Melanoma breakthrough: Moderna vaccine succeeds and shares explode](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd668be-3df1-4d12-8578-b4c9cb919a4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Moderna shares surged after the company and Merck reported their personalized mRNA cancer vaccine combined with Keytruda **[met primary and secondary goals in a Phase 3 trial of more than 1,100 melanoma patients.](https://substack.com/redirect/a3a8ed19-515f-46b9-9f84-d275d0a92054?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd668be-3df1-4d12-8578-b4c9cb919a4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Phase three trial success:** The combination extended the time patients lived without melanoma returning compared with Keytruda alone and also reduced the risk of the cancer spreading to distant body parts.
* **Personalized vaccine approach:** The mRNA shot is designed around unique mutations in each patient's tumor and pairs with Merck's immunotherapy to train the immune system against those specific markers.
* **Regulatory path ahead:** The companies plan to present detailed data at an upcoming medical meeting and will begin discussions with regulators in the coming months about potential approval.
* **Stock market reaction:** Moderna shares soared more than 60% in premarket trading while Merck climbed in early trading, reflecting the first positive late-stage result for an mRNA cancer vaccine.

# [542% in one day: Chinese robot stock Unitree goes vertical](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd668be-3df1-4d12-8578-b4c9cb919a4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Unitree Robotics **[shares jumped 542% in early trading on their Shanghai debut](https://substack.com/redirect/f5a4e15c-d99a-4e44-a1b7-749dc67a7a6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after the Chinese humanoid robot maker raised about 6.1 billion yuan, or $905 million, in its initial public offering.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd668be-3df1-4d12-8578-b4c9cb919a4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Shares hit highs:** Unitree shares climbed to 968.1 yuan after reaching as high as 1,100 yuan during the Shanghai STAR Market debut that drew heavy early investor interest in the robotics maker.
* **Investor group strong:** AI company DeepSeek invested about 140.8 million yuan while existing backers include technology giant Tencent, boosting the profile of the Hangzhou-based humanoid robot company.
* **Superman robot specs:** Unitree unveiled its new Superman humanoid that can jump two meters from a standing start and run at speeds of up to 12.66 meters per second ahead of the listing.
* **Market size growth:** Morgan Stanley raised its China humanoid robot shipment forecast to 50,000 units this year and expects the overall market to expand from $2 billion to $15 billion by 2030.

* * *
* * *
# [Target raises outlook after Q2 beat and surprise tariff refund](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd668be-3df1-4d12-8578-b4c9cb919a4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Target **[posted second-quarter net sales growth of 5.3%](https://substack.com/redirect/f886b4f4-4375-4499-8bad-d71ad7f52806?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and comparable sales of 3.8% that topped estimates, while a $752 million tariff refund lifted earnings and led the retailer to raise its full-year guidance.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd668be-3df1-4d12-8578-b4c9cb919a4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Broad category strength:** All six major categories grew with food and beauty leading the gains while apparel and home lagged, which executives describe as multiyear journeys requiring more assortment changes for better results.
* **Digital sales surge:** Digital comparable sales rose 8.7% while same-day delivery climbed more than 25%, helping push overall comparable sales to 3.8% that beat the 2.4% Wall Street consensus estimate.
* **Full year guidance:** Target raised its net sales growth outlook to about 5% and now expects full-year EPS of $9.90 to $10.90 including refunds or $8.25 to $9.25 excluding the benefit.
* **Price cuts expand:** The company has lowered prices on more than 10,000 items with additional reductions planned and opened 17 new stores even as the CEO stressed durable growth remains the priority.

# [Estee Lauder surges after crushing sales and raising margins](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd668be-3df1-4d12-8578-b4c9cb919a4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd668be-3df1-4d12-8578-b4c9cb919a4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Fourth quarter beat:** Adjusted earnings reached 39 cents per share versus the 32-cent consensus while organic sales grew 5%, marking the fourth consecutive quarter of organic growth for the company.
* **Full year recovery:** Full-year adjusted EPS rose to $2.51 from $1.51 a year earlier with net sales increasing 5% to about $15 billion, ending a stretch of annual revenue declines.
* **Guidance improvement:** The company reaffirmed 3% to 5% organic sales growth for fiscal 2027 and raised the adjusted operating margin midpoint while confirming net reduction of about 10,000 jobs.
* **Category performance:** Skin care and fragrance led growth in the quarter as the company continues efforts to speed product launches and reach younger shoppers through digital platforms.

# [Trump pauses 50% Canada tariffs after forcing a deal](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd668be-3df1-4d12-8578-b4c9cb919a4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
President Donald Trump late Tuesday **[paused 50% tariffs on certain Canadian imports that were set to take effect at midnight,](https://substack.com/redirect/70b04d84-c632-44fc-b686-451d2cdfbd67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** saying the United States and Canada have a deal subject to finalizing documents.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd668be-3df1-4d12-8578-b4c9cb919a4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Talks with Mark Carney:** The pause followed trade discussions between Trump and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on Tuesday ahead of the scheduled tariff implementation under Section 338 of the 1930 Tariff Act.
* **Targeted goods and value:** The duties would have hit roughly $20 billion of Canadian imports including hockey sticks, wine and other consumer products after complaints of discrimination in vehicle, alcohol and dairy sectors.
* **Small business concerns:** Canadian Federation of Independent Business president Dan Kelly said a 50% tariff would render products uneconomic and could halt U.S. sales for many of the group's 103,000 members.
* **Keystone pipeline mention:** Trump indicated the Keystone XL pipeline might be revived as part of the arrangement while previous tariffs on metals, lumber and other Canadian goods remain in place.

# [DSA falls short as Moskowitz takes Florida primary](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd668be-3df1-4d12-8578-b4c9cb919a4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Democratic Representative Jared Moskowitz was projected Tuesday to win the Democratic primary in Florida's 25th congressional district, defeating Oliver Larkin **[who was backed by the Democratic Socialists of America.](https://substack.com/redirect/87fb0592-bf80-4d38-b443-3bc006f7cf49?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd668be-3df1-4d12-8578-b4c9cb919a4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **New district after redistricting:** Moskowitz competed in a newly drawn seat after Florida completed redistricting this year designed to help Republicans gain additional House seats in the upcoming November general election.
* **Republican primary undecided:** The Republican nomination contest in the 25th district remains unresolved with five candidates still in the race including former Boca Raton Mayor Scott Singer as of Tuesday night.
* **Map boosts Republican majority:** Florida's revised congressional map is projected to deliver Republicans as many as four more seats and potentially produce a 24-to-4 Republican edge in the state's House delegation.
* **Primaries signal midterm trends:** Contests in Florida and Alaska drew close attention as early indicators of Republican or Democratic momentum before November elections decide control of Congress.

subject: It’s time to retire Matsui
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Justice Democrats
body:
Mai Vang is a voice for the people of Sacramento who’ve been left behind by Rep. Doris Matsui.
#
Peter,
For 20 years, Rep. Doris Matsui’s hold on power in Sacramento remained intact and largely unchallenged — until Justice Democrat Mai Vang stepped up and outperformed her in June’s Democratic primary election.
Matsui went to extreme lengths to stop our momentum in the CA-07 primary race. First, **she requested that her corporate Super PAC donors focus on boosting the Republican** candidate in a desperate attempt to push Mai out.
When that failed, **she transferred $1.4 million of her own wealth** in the final weeks — a step she’s NEVER taken in her 10 prior re-election campaigns.
But Mai didn’t just survive the top-two primary — _she came out on top with the most votes._ And now, she’s facing Matsui again in November’s general election.
**[We need to be prepared for whatever Matsui and her corporate megadonors throw our way between now and November 3rd, Peter. Rush $10 to Mai’s campaign and Justice Democrats now to make sure we can fight back!](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260819-mv.4F3PA3&refcode=em20260819-38177&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=2&akid=38177%2E1203867%2Etb5CW7)**
**[Contribute ››](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260819-mv.4F3PA3&refcode=em20260819-38177&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=3&akid=38177%2E1203867%2Etb5CW7)**
This race represents a stark contrast for the future of Sacramento:
* **AIPAC & Special Interests:** Matsui has received campaign contributions from AIPAC for years while voting to enable Israel’s genocide of Palestinians. Mai supports Palestinian rights and self-determination, and led the passing of a ceasefire resolution on Sacramento’s city council.
* **Standing up to ICE:** Matsui tried to take credit for opposing ICE, but voted to fund them _five times_ while accepting money from the contractors carrying out their inhumane detainment and mass deportations. Mai supports abolishing ICE and has led the charge locally to defend Sacramento from ICE terror.
* **Corporate PACs vs. Grassroots Power:** Nearly half of Matsui’s campaign funding comes from corporate PACs, raking in hundreds of thousands of dollars from the very corporations hiking up prices on the working class. Mai has never taken a cent from corporate PACs, and never will.

Mai is a voice for the people of Sacramento who’ve been left behind by the 50-year Matsui dynasty — running to be a congresswoman who’s actually accountable to her community.
**We know Mai can win again in November,_but only if this grassroots team keeps showing up._ No matter the size, every contribution gets us one step closer to sending another Justice Democrat to join our progressive bloc in Congress.
**[Chip in any amount to Mai’s campaign and Justice Democrats today so we can put an end to the Matsui dynasty for good and give CA-07 the leader they deserve >>](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260819-mv.4F3PA3&refcode=em20260819-38177&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=4&akid=38177%2E1203867%2Etb5CW7)**
**[Contribute $10](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260819-mv.4F3PA3&refcode=em20260819-38177&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=23&akid=38177%2E1203867%2Etb5CW7)**
In solidarity,
Justice Democrats

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20260819-38177-footer&t=24&refcode2=38177_1203867_tb5CW7&akid=38177%2E1203867%2Etb5CW7)**

| WRITE A LETTER - GET ACTIVE!
---
| |

| Dear Peter,
This November, Massachusetts voters will face nine statewide ballot questions that will shape how we elect our leaders, how government spends our money, and whether we protect fundamental rights. Letters to the editor remain one of the most effective ways ordinary citizens can reach their neighbors, inform undecided voters, and show that real people care about these issues.
Please review the below one-sheet summarizing the Massachusetts Republican Party's positions on each question, then write in your own voice sharing a personal example, keep it concise, factual, and respectful, and submit it to your local newspaper.
Every published letter helps make sure conservative, common-sense voices are heard. Thank you for stepping up.
\- Haley
Haley Jones Executive Director Massachusetts Republican Party

body:
I'm not going to sugarcoat anything or blow things out of proportion. I simply want you to hear the truth straight from me.
| To: Fellow Patriot
From: Vice President JD Vance
---

---
I wish I could give you a call, but I hope this letter will do.
Before anything else, I need to thank you.
Your loyalty and willingness to stand with President Trump and me through it all mean more than you know.
As a Marine and proud son of the Rust Belt, honesty and loyalty mean everything to me.
That's why I wanted to write to you directly and have an honest conversation on where things stand.
I'm not going to sugarcoat anything or blow things out of proportion. I simply want you to hear the truth straight from me.
First, I owe you an explanation.
I recently heard that some people received texts and emails threatening to remove them from the GOP unless they donated money.
I couldn't believe it.
I grew up around people who didn't have extra money lying around. Good people. Loyal people. Patriotic people.
You are the foundation of the MAGA movement.
If those messages reached you, please know that's not how I see things.
To me, you're MAGA whether you donate or not.
Your support, your voice, and your belief in this movement matter far more than any single contribution ever could.
Second, the Midterms are now less than 100 days away, and we still have a lot of work to do.
President Trump, Republican leadership, and MAGA leaders across the country have been working around the clock--crunching the numbers and building a strategy to protect our House Majority.
Our biggest concern is that Democrats are preparing to spend MILLIONS to target 44 Republican-held seats across the country.
The scale of what they're planning is unlike anything we've seen before.
If they're successful, we can expect endless investigations into President Trump's cabinet, constant blocking of the MAGA agenda, and, worst of all, impeachment against President Trump.
We can't let that happen.
That's why, as we enter the final stretch before Election Day, I'm humbly asking you to stay in this fight with us.
Whether it's reading updates like this, staying informed, spreading the word, or chipping in to help us compete with the Democrats' fundraising machine, every action makes a difference.
The next 100 days could determine the fate of the MAGA Movement.
[If you're able, even a dollar for every day remaining until Election Day would make a tremendous difference.](http://links.maga-conservatives.com/u/click?_t=da215d85003f407c964bf56cae76557f&_m=9b2086de10484b39aa0db67f3fa9fba5&_e=tF7hLSfGO9qiV51ulkzz2J-neU9ShGqFWP3aeg7vNapmzLWkJBeQ21OOdt6uoDhcpMBLbTo1qNJ7WuiEnX8pP7MXZBYyTMPmDblSjQDMLv9GEkoClnwM60m935WJBiJJy3XDmDL5JJGEdDlDwQWDRF_JALIaPnx3WvsToP10Kv3Eg7jhwm7bDn1yUZjug3TZoytbgsccIf_vYmYoYpLH3ekrUNg1V_7rzsP0DIjuHzandwp9khiU1-DFNUrwtEIzWLtL_Ylgh1AMX0khafbuXKPSddXUmvQVzi20Agh3HUV4ACyW29tpuwcZ5mTQom8Hoxu2K9itmFJsvXivjSESJv7nSeZhiRO4Hd3nZISWf5pRWZwvuoHS4F1Z5jIPSc-PfrANPOXH0QKv_X_FGCsLT6xvPu4t0aDWw8OwWG-IavCqT_qwgntfrDQ8k1-xS9EX0Fah72oV61iqcMvxIffic-B48fxK7UuUQSnQ3keKteNbDFDofQSAuz4QYhgUzxmwKP3M81DqsxC0LuLAqxD4dWzi_bdG1xufv0iprJgWXJMJJ0YEi4ZKHrG5dHMuYnZg0VJ1EN_LRV0UrjRmX4gw2zPQzrhF3Gj7T8czXJ6En4WWf7Ksgp7GzahCyQON6dA-4oNY7uqYY7zvsLFiXWxRCPz-PLg2uRRW1Jmd_6cNkeXXy_cpxdF07t1XjzLQ8RyTiGyUuq_NUXxN67r1L_tAPVXiR-R3p-H4RSFP-gK15KU%3D)

body:
Yesterday, Alaskans cast their ballots in the state’s top-four primary election.
#
Hi there,
Yesterday, Alaskans cast their ballots in the state’s top-four primary election. Under Alaska’s system, the top four vote-getters advance to the general election, regardless of party affiliation. Here’s what happened in the races we’re targeting this November:
* * *
**Senate**
In the Senate race, former Congresswoman **Mary Peltola** is currently the top vote-getter in the race—a great sign for her prospects in the general election this November. She’ll face incumbent Republican Senator**Dan Sullivan,** along with the two other candidates who finish with the 3rd and 4th most votes in the primary. The results are currently too close to call, and election officials have until August 28th to finish tabulating mail-in ballots.
Sullivan is seeking a third term, but Peltola, who was the first Native Alaskan elected to Congress, has a strong chance of defeating him on Election Day. In the first quarter of 2026, she outraised Sullivan roughly 5-to-1, pulling in a record $8.9 million with 95% of donations under $100 from across Alaska.
Peltola has also won statewide twice before, and she outperformed Vice President Kamala Harris by 11 points in 2024. Plus, two recent polls show her leading Sullivan by anywhere from 2 to 6 points.
**[Right now, the best way to support Peltola is by donating directly to her campaign through Swing Left so that she can reach as many voters across this massive state as possible before November.](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=sl-senate-ak-2026.QiAB-7&refcode=em20260819-2498&t=1&akid=2498%2E1562180%2EabCpSZ)**
* * *
**House**
Alaska has one at-large House district, and in that race, the top two vote-getters so far are independent**Bill Hill** and Republican incumbent **Nick Begich**. Like in the Senate race, the 3rd and 4th-place finishers, who will also advance to the general election, have not yet been determined.
With no viable Democratic candidate in the race, Swing Left will be working to support **Bill Hill** in the general election. When the last viable Democrat dropped out of the race two months ago, he immediately endorsed Hill. Alaska’s labor unions have also backed his campaign, and polling shows he has a viable path to defeating Begich this November.
With the ability to win over Republican and independent voters in a state that went for Trump by double digits, Hill could pull off one of the most consequential upsets of the entire cycle and make Alaska’s At-Large seat one of the districts that decides the House majority.
[**Right now, the best way to support candidates like Bill Hill in our “Reach” races is by signing up to volunteer with Ground Truth today. You can canvass in a race near you, or participate in a virtual phone bank from anywhere in the country.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/1218?utm_source=em20260819-2498&t=2&akid=2498%2E1562180%2EabCpSZ)
Ground Truth is Swing Left’s innovative volunteer-led voter contact program that reinvents how we canvass and phone bank to build trust and win over the voters we need.
* * *
In both the House and Senate races, winning Alaska will not be easy. Voters in the state have elected Republicans reliably for most of Alaska’s history, and in 2024, Donald Trump won the state by 13%.
That being said, a majority of voters are registered undeclared or nonpartisan, and voters regularly cross party lines, meaning this race is going to be close, but not impossible—and the support of the Swing Left community has the potential to make the difference between winning and losing in November.
Thank you, as always, for everything you do, and make sure to stay tuned for more updates soon!
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20260819-1&t=3&refcode2=2498_1562180_abCpSZ&akid=2498%2E1562180%2EabCpSZ)

body:
They are not coming after me — they are coming after YOU

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/UKgQtF0cS1o?e=1facf02470&c2id=205919520b3860dafbe9b9f5dda2019d)
| |
Dear Friend,
In January 2026, investigators received hard evidence of possible election fraud in the 2025 Prop 50 vote.
An audit of Riverside County election materials showed a shocking discrepancy: the Registrar of Voters received 611,428 ballots — yet the certified results reported 657,322 votes.
**That’s 45,896 more votes than ballots received**.
In February, investigators obtained a valid search warrant, signed by a judge, to examine those ballots. The moment it was served, Attorney General Rob Bonta launched pure lawfare.
He raced to Superior Court, then the Court of Appeals — both rejected him — and is now at the California Supreme Court, not to challenge the merits of the investigation, but to shut it down entirely.
This is political corruption and the weaponization of the justice system. Bonta is arguing that he has the power to stop any investigation he doesn’t like — especially one that could expose Democrat election irregularities.
**This is an attack on election integrity**.

Bonta and I will both make our cases before the California Supreme Court on Monday. If he wins, the Court will grant him full authority to halt ANY lawful investigation — including future investigations into himself.
Do not believe the spin from the AG’s office or the media. This is a legal, judge-approved investigation into possible election fraud that Bonta desperately wants stopped.
We must all ask ourselves why.
Make no mistake: **they are not coming after me — they are coming after YOU**.
They are coming after anyone who defends the rule of law. They want to make an example of this case so no sheriff, no investigator, and no patriot ever dares look under the hood of California’s elections again.
**We cannot let them win.**
Rob Bonta and his Democrat lawyers have already spent $250,000 of your tax dollars trying to silence this investigation — and they plan to spend millions more.
I am humbly asking for your support to defeat Bonta in court.
**Please contribute today to help us fight back.**
Thank you,

My name is Mary Peltola, and after yesterday’s primary, I am officially running in the general election for United States Senate in Alaska.

I want to share with you why I made the decision to run – and to ask for your support as we begin the general election together.

[**_But if you already understand how important this race and your support are, and you’re ready to join our fight for fish, family, and freedom, please use this button to split a contribution between my campaign for U.S. Senate and Kirsten Gillibrand:_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137539027/641113930/1236930992?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.08.19_peltola-split_B1_F1_S1_C1_120DO150DC150DD_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMmRlZDJmYi1mYjliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0YHawfsTWZg78b88ZfxKCeoMmcNG-HaYBp8t4O3IoaM=) | | [ CONTRIBUTE >> ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137539028/641113931/1236930992?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.08.19_peltola-split_B1_F1_S1_C1_120DO150DC150DD_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMmRlZDJmYi1mYjliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0YHawfsTWZg78b88ZfxKCeoMmcNG-HaYBp8t4O3IoaM=)

Now here’s a bit more on how I came to this decision.

When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.

Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.

Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.

So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families.

And I’ve got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying nearly 20 bucks for a gallon of fuel. They don’t even believe us.

They’re focused on their own wallets – not ours.

And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest.

It’s why our prices keep rising, all while the healthcare and services Alaskans rely on get gutted.

I’m done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home.

My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning.

But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption.

I’m running for Alaska’s Senate seat because it is the fight for our future.

**This is going to be the closest and most consequential Senate race this year, and I cannot do this alone. There is only one way we’ll be able to flip this seat... and that is together.**

So I am asking:

[**_Please split a contribution between Kirsten Gillibrand and my campaign for the U.S. Senate today as we begin the general election. We are looking for a huge number of day one donors to get our general election campaign off to a strong start and put us in a position to win. No donation is too small. clean_body: Hello – My name is Mary Peltola, and after yesterday’s primary, I am officially running in the general election for United States Senate in Alaska. I want to share with you why I made the decision to run – and to ask for your support as we begin the general election together. = | | = Now here’s a bit more on how I came to this decision. When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance. Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity. Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find. So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families. And I’ve got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying nearly 20 bucks for a gallon of fuel. They don’t even believe us. They’re focused on their own wallets – not ours. And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest. It’s why our prices keep rising, all while the healthcare and services Alaskans rely on get gutted. I’m done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home. My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning. But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption. I’m running for Alaska’s Senate seat because it is the fight for our future. This is going to be the closest and most consequential Senate race this year, and I cannot do this alone. There is only one way we’ll be able to flip this seat... and that is together. Yesterday we delivered opening arguments in our case against Meta. We filed this lawsuit as a bipartisan coalition of state attorneys general because Meta created harmful features on Facebook and Instagram that are designed to drive compulsive use among children and teenagers. Studies have made clear that the more time kids spend on social media, the greater the correlation with depression, anxiety, body image issues, susceptibility to addiction, and interference with learning and daily life.__ And millions of parents, guardians, teachers, and healthcare providers have seen this play out in real life. body:
...quietly logging where people drive, when, and how often. | | | | [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquO38L98SklfBdoDq94y0bmNpGkqxcvbwAwPTl2twJS_DaQ6rO1kJyrioj4TkVwp7cCw3bZNK4mQ_bH4PdkRxiKg8EQoUFYDVXfkQPK-6jF4I1Yf08wtii6OW_-pdaki-QuV41dq129SzcSRJsj2riJ8St_hRMukjlt9TaP6YzNYiGznKsPGVTGZ-WleyHOKM7Wcpe0hYo-nFSlJ-Nl8XbZa9rb18KZ_eUkPFdGtbgiJ6bfctE3O93jNUA-uEgb31V1nHwzCkSyQj86Bo7zzNy1_9bQoG0cAfjNB29FIGbuvvBBM187T9YEon2Mq-0rVfjAoabZIPI9fIdFb6PNKyaP/4tb/_7ZqGyakRJqHT1XsHYIaDA/h0/h001.-1OaHKwsDojy_AyYJKm4fg-T8ONSmV0BNRsNgq28YLA)
---
Team,

Across the Sacramento region, a sprawling network of automated license plate reader cameras — many made by a company called Flock — are quietly logging where people drive, when, and how often.

[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uDKkapQVnT18L0ER7M9Fm5ErqyLxalxtNW_IwOmilrjvxsZnil3x0YVns-draoT7Z2gDaU637S5-hJYlStTvGd6QtdTU1VlDgfhfEfmLcuGY-FTuQiEQZ0K80xhX06QY0YL2h76G7JulWF3yNEuUBl7p2FUDZ9Fvle3bhgY4fZDFefcj5M5TyIql3kL63hr1bqxpVJRoqdzcDPNQL7t08aItFgQ4Y-IIdZnraUIkQ-emo6puVTcfKwwHCRkUfmgqo6x7gZfcpsjASTjIyVdWxNOdxClamZFUPZuYfgwoSSSw5EcTR8bjPQpsrd_DwgbjwsGBRb3D6hgGrDNEnpipr/4tb/_7ZqGyakRJqHT1XsHYIaDA/h1/h001.5ZoWAZ1FdalO3hf5a-DyzgHZkB_flIz42FVy_lVHZ2o)
This isn't one camera watching one intersection. These systems photograph passing cars, record the time and location, and store that data in searchable databases.

In Elk Grove alone, an audit found that more than 3,600 outside organizations ran over 8 million searches of residents' plate data between 2021 and early 2026 — with 97% of those searches coming from agencies outside our community entirely.

Sit with that for a second. There's a permanent, searchable record of your daily movements — where you worship, where you take your kids, where you go to the doctor — built without your consent and shared far beyond the town that collected it.

And these systems aren't even reliable. In nearby Roseville, 71% of the alerts Flock cameras generated for stolen or felony-linked vehicles turned out to be misreads.

I've spent my career fighting to protect the privacy and dignity of the people in our communities, and I'm not going to stop now. That fight has to include drawing a hard line on mass surveillance.

You’ve probably noticed that a lot of political emails are designed to make you panic.

**[We need to send an unmistakable message that we don’t want to be spied on. Add your name to my petition calling for an outright ban on new surveillance systems like Flock in the Sacramento area.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uDKkapQVnT18L0ER7M9Fm5ErqyLxalxtNW_IwOmilrjvxsZnil3x0YVns-draoT7Z2gDaU637S5-hJYlStTvGd6QtdTU1VlDgfhfEfmLcuGY-FTuQiEQZ0K80xhX06Qbf3Xrmw5pSEX_OEzrlD7tHjV2QkubSDALLZ23gHcUQ2UucxO9m3SKeVJB3hjZHYJIKuIFud76Rm7K9_pt8DKfV7cDelG7rYFWHARZ31SAtQD7iFhVV2cHVMvZ9rYonkaz9eycl8zsSMMkcuL1_elA2qSDgE3LZPmaUEupf8FRjzbHbILltjYgpW2UJ--g-bMXIZVpa7Sc3OsmLymlUCQDz/4tb/_7ZqGyakRJqHT1XsHYIaDA/h2/h001.foj_knNIgFfDBGmZyWTwePAljGiPkSNvm-yXil86ryc)**

| **[SIGN THE PETITION](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uDKkapQVnT18L0ER7M9Fm5ErqyLxalxtNW_IwOmilrjvxsZnil3x0YVns-draoT7Z2gDaU637S5-hJYlStTvGd6QtdTU1VlDgfhfEfmLcuGY-FTuQiEQZ0K80xhX06QYTxKAFrnU91Y9fiSiise9AwC3w9oIWCyLCF2OptZLae7T85RRfOQBttYyLb-O2NecEgH-UJv0jQAYIRWgDQLOCp6W-CQdrN_6p2BaebUpBXJvNxAI2TtKgxTIrwDN0-CvKS1QkAPHbNChWUFGDNw8pT3NpQBTrnPTSvngtdi2YhKhtfoIlncAO0DGcC7cVt3HpaZfD5tx1n7kdVuZ31xHz/4tb/_7ZqGyakRJqHT1XsHYIaDA/h3/h001.Enl8JYlj-h9-3sk6ejPido9IXt0202MRYliB8ksJZWY) **
---

We need hard limits on how long our data is stored, full transparency about who it's shared with, and an absolute ban on handing this data over for immigration enforcement, so no family in our community has to live in fear of being tracked and targeted.

Add your name, and let's draw the line together.

With heart and hustle,
Mai |

Mai is the daughter of Hmong refugees, born and raised in Sacramento. Mai’s parents fled war in Laos and arrived in California to find a new life.

As the oldest of 16 children, she helped raise her siblings while working hard to build a career dedicated to helping her community thrive. Mai is a proud product of public schools and was the first in her family to attend college. As a young organizer, Mai returned home to serve the community that raised and supported her.

My name is Mary Peltola, and after yesterday’s primary, I am officially running in the general election for United States Senate in Alaska.

I want to share with you why I made the decision to run – and to ask for your support as we begin the general election together.

But if you already understand how important this race and your support are, and you’re ready to join our fight for fish, family, and freedom, please use this button to split a contribution between my campaign for U.S. Senate and Maggie Hassan: | | [ DONATE NOW >> ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137540312/641116742/-328725030?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.08.19_Mary-Peltola-Split_B2_F1_S1_C1_90OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTk1NzAxNC1mZTliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QhrOOCFqY9uUG9rzTFIyKmieHZVNf0wr4CzoTgx6JBA=)
---
Now here’s a bit more on how I came to this decision.

When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.

Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.

Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.

So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families.

And I've got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying nearly 20 bucks for a gallon of fuel. They don’t even believe us.

They're focused on their own wallets – not ours.

And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest.

It’s why our prices keep rising, all while the healthcare and services Alaskans rely on get gutted.

I'm done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home.

My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning.

But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption.

I'm running for Alaska's Senate seat because it is the fight for our future.

**This is going to be the closest and most consequential Senate race this year, and I cannot do this alone. There is only one way we’ll be able to flip this seat... and that is together.**

So I am asking:

[**_Please split a contribution between Maggie Hassan and my campaign for the U.S. Senate today as we begin the general election. We are looking for a huge number of day one donors to get our general election campaign off to a strong start and put us in a position to win. No donation is too small. They will all add up fast to give us the resources we need to WIN in November._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137540313/641116743/-328725030?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.08.19_Mary-Peltola-Split_B2_F1_S1_C1_90OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTk1NzAxNC1mZTliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QhrOOCFqY9uUG9rzTFIyKmieHZVNf0wr4CzoTgx6JBA=)

clean_body: | = Hello - My name is Mary Peltola, and after yesterday’s primary, I am officially running in the general election for United States Senate in Alaska. I want to share with you why I made the decision to run – and to ask for your support as we begin the general election together. But if you already understand how important this race and your support are, and you’re ready to join our fight for fish, family, and freedom, please use this button to split a contribution between my campaign for U.S. Senate and Maggie Hassan: | | = Now here’s a bit more on how I came to this decision. When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance. Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity. Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find. So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families. And I've got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying nearly 20 bucks for a gallon of fuel. They don’t even believe us. They're focused on their own wallets – not ours. And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest. It’s why our prices keep rising, all while the healthcare and services Alaskans rely on get gutted. I'm done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home. My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning. But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption. I'm running for Alaska's Senate seat because it is the fight for our future. subject: Floatzilla!
body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137540574/641117521/-1060083271?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYWFmNGNjYy1mZTliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bTRN4L3ZtAb-VJLviLhfPhqKQRh530tKonIrtcXP9-U=)
Peter, This past weekend, I loaded up the kayak and headed down to the river for **Floatzilla!** The weather turned out to be perfect, and the energy even better! If you're not from the Quad Cities or have never floated with us in the 17 years of Floatzilla, picture this: Thousands of us, out on the Mississippi River in kayaks and canoes, all paddling together on the same stretch of water, taking the
opportunity to explore the area's natural beauty. It's the largest paddling event on the entire river, and **it happens right here in our district.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137540575/641117522/-1060083271?refcode=em-8.19.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYWFmNGNjYy1mZTliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bTRN4L3ZtAb-VJLviLhfPhqKQRh530tKonIrtcXP9-U=) I covered Floatzilla for years as a meteorologist before I ever thought about running for Congress. There's something about being out on that water – surrounded by neighbors from every corner of the Quad Cities and new friends from all over the country – that reminds me exactly why I love this district and why I do this job. It's also a good reminder of what's actually at stake when we talk about protecting our rivers and our environment. The Mississippi is a part of our everyday life, our recreation, and our local economy. It’s something I'll always fight to protect, because we should never take this mighty river for granted. Thank you for letting me share a little bit of my weekend with you. If you're able, [**I'd be grateful for your support as we keep this campaign moving toward November.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137540576/641117523/-1060083271?refcode=em-8.19.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYWFmNGNjYy1mZTliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bTRN4L3ZtAb-VJLviLhfPhqKQRh530tKonIrtcXP9-U=) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137540577/641117524/-1060083271?refcode=em-8.19.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYWFmNGNjYy1mZTliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bTRN4L3ZtAb-VJLviLhfPhqKQRh530tKonIrtcXP9-U=) | **[Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137540578/641117525/-1060083271?refcode=em-8.19.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYWFmNGNjYy1mZTliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bTRN4L3ZtAb-VJLviLhfPhqKQRh530tKonIrtcXP9-U=)**
---
**Thank you to River Action Quad Cities for bringing us all together again!** They put in an incredible amount of work every year to make it happen, and it's one of my favorite days on the calendar.

clean_body: | = Peter, This past weekend, I loaded up the kayak and headed down to the river for Floatzilla! The weather turned out to be perfect, and the energy even better! If you're not from the Quad Cities or have never floated with us in the 17 years of Floatzilla, picture this: Thousands of us, out on the Mississippi River in kayaks and canoes, all paddling together on the same stretch of water, taking the opportunity to explore the area's natural beauty. It's the largest paddling event on the entire river, and it happens right here in our district. = I covered Floatzilla for years as a meteorologist before I ever thought about running for Congress. There's something about being out on that water – surrounded by neighbors from every corner of the Quad Cities and new friends from all over the country – that reminds me exactly why I love this district and why I do this job. It's also a good reminder of what's actually at stake when we talk about protecting our rivers and our environment. The Mississippi is a part of our everyday life, our recreation, and our local economy. It’s something I'll always fight to protect, because we should never take this mighty river for granted. Thank you for letting me share a little bit of my weekend with you. If you're able, = = | = Thank you to River Action Quad Cities for bringing us all together again! They put in an incredible amount of work every year to make it happen, and it's one of my favorite days on the calendar. Justice Samuel Alito has made almost $3 MILLION from oil and gas since he
joined the Supreme Court — from sitting on the bench while he and his
family's oil interests quietly grew richer.

Now, Alito is about to rule on a case that could shield fossil fuel giants
like Exxon and Suncor from lawsuits over the climate damage they've
caused.

And here’s the kicker: he won't recuse himself.^1 The Supreme Court's
"ethics code" lets justices police themselves, so Alito gets to decide
whether his own oil money disqualifies him.

That's how broken the system is. A judge with a direct tie to the industry
at the center of a case, and no one can force him to step aside. It's
absurd.

Alito and the other extremist judges on this Court don't answer to the
people or the Constitution. They answer to fossil fuel executives,
billionaires, and Donald Trump — the people who've spent decades building
a Court that rules for them, again and again, while the rest of us are
left with nothing.

We cannot let this continue. Demand Justice PAC is exposing this corrupt
Court, demanding accountability and transparency, and mobilizing at the
grassroots to keep the pressure on.

body:
Congress must place meaningful guardrails on ICE.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137541773/641120967/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNTExZDg0ZS0wMDljLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GFmFfGuf9pfKQp9pgEbaCe5ZQhAD8j-w-GlL8fNCuDE=&emci=966f377d-f397-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&emdi=3511d84e-009c-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ceid=9494239)
---

| | The Administration's immigration enforcement agenda is tearing families apart, creating fear throughout our communities, and harming our local economy. **That is why I visited the ICE holding facility in Ferndale to conduct congressional oversight and get answers for the people I represent.** While I learned more about the facility's detention procedures, access to legal counsel, and the role of Homeland Security Investigations in local enforcement operations, I _did not_ receive complete answers to all of my questions. I will continue pressing ICE and the Department of Homeland Security for the transparency and accountability my constituents deserve. **My oversight of both the Ferndale ICE holding facility and the privately operated ICE detention center in Tacoma has reinforced my belief that Congress must place meaningful guardrails on ICE.** I will not support legislation that funds the agency without requiring it to meet the same standards of accountability as every other local, state, and federal law enforcement agency. That includes:
* Prohibiting ICE officers from wearing masks during arrests or using restricted equipment such as tear gas.
* Requiring ICE officers to receive de-escalation training.
* Ending family and child detention and DHS's use of private detention facilities.
* Guaranteeing individuals in immigration detention unlimited access to legal counsel.
* Repealing the Alien Enemies Act, which President Trump has used to deport immigrants from Venezuela without due process.
* Requiring complete and independent investigations into the deaths of individuals in ICE custody and other killings of unarmed civilians.

**My office is also establishing a process so that people detained at the Ferndale facility can request assistance from my staff.** No family should have to navigate the immigration system alone, and I will continue working to ensure my constituents have access to the information, resources, and representation they need while continuing to push for a more transparent, accountable, and humane immigration system. clean_body: Congress must place meaningful guardrails on ICE. | | | | The Administration's immigration enforcement agenda is tearing families apart, creating fear throughout our communities, and harming our local economy. That is why I visited the ICE holding facility in Ferndale to conduct congressional oversight and get answers for the people I represent. While I learned more about the facility's detention procedures, access to legal counsel, and the role of Homeland Security Investigations in local enforcement operations, I did not receive complete answers to all of my questions. I will continue pressing ICE and the Department of Homeland Security for the transparency and accountability my constituents deserve. My oversight of both the Ferndale ICE holding facility and the privately operated ICE detention center in Tacoma has reinforced my belief that Congress must place meaningful guardrails on ICE. I will not support legislation that funds the agency without requiring it to meet the same standards of accountability as every other local, state, and federal law enforcement agency. That includes: Prohibiting ICE officers from wearing masks during arrests or using restricted equipment such as tear gas. Requiring ICE officers to receive de-escalation training. Ending family and child detention and DHS's use of private detention facilities. Guaranteeing individuals in immigration detention unlimited access to legal counsel. Repealing the Alien Enemies Act, which President Trump has used to deport immigrants from Venezuela without due process. Requiring complete and independent investigations into the deaths of individuals in ICE custody and other killings of unarmed civilians. My office is also establishing a process so that people detained at the Ferndale facility can request assistance from my staff. No family should have to navigate the immigration system alone, and I will continue working to ensure my constituents have access to the information, resources, and representation they need while continuing to push for a more transparent, accountable, and humane immigration system. body:

| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001PB6JD15kDsuO4iWyX74fFf_X8dV6GxDnOtI32Bc2tL42N6HDsT0Ei07EtFiQM_Q3Pr60O9_ycxtTFQUzZas3FUB8iHOW2sHxaQJPjFIueBFfn86qJ8VtwPlKNQh9cNEPM0x6peSREWJz8MYBt9W5eqcaCzBryGA4rSC97Pu6aHRGWG8M39fWL0VjXk365iafrtxY10VBuy0mA_nQ0XVfaCS_kUyBPqrM7E3CkGcqTw8=&c=HEZhHkipZKjpYqHdkoIqLKMOpxe661jq8VLQpOh4K8k_UdxNkT5HqA==&ch=KhUC8FlyZYZefcqG_EL2Ymf_2SHu-MQsj3_9cIpcbwXfTcCYlNFzDw==)
